africa.are:38002.name: a Tribal Encampment concealed beneath the soil and stone
africa.are:38002.description: Rough stone and packed earth enclose a concealed encampment beneath the ground. Fabric screens divide the shelter into close, irregular spaces, their lower edges dusted with soil. A clear camp center leaves room to gather beneath the low stone overhead.

africa.are:38010.name: a KFC in Giza
africa.are:38010.description: Red-and-white trim borders a hard-wearing dining space. Molded seating faces compact tables, and a `wservice counter`x organizes the customer side of the restaurant.
places: service counter
The service counter has a smooth front edge and a scatter of small handling marks across the top. The customer side leaves room to lean beside a companion while taking in the room beyond.

africa.are:38013.name: a Pizza Hut in Giza
africa.are:38013.description: Warm red accents and practical dining furniture fill the restaurant. Booth breaks the floor into small alcoves, with the central standing space kept clear between them.
places: booth
Opposing benches gather around a compact table. Worn cushions and high backs make the booth a snug enclosure, with the surrounding room kept just beyond the shoulders of the seated company.

africa.are:38015.name: a Bustling Open-Air Bazaar
africa.are:38015.description: Canvas awnings overlap above the open-air bazaar, breaking the light into strips across the dusty ground. Closely spaced stalls leave narrow aisles between their displays. A worn `wcounter`x faces the passing trade, surrounded by the mingled scents of cloth, spice, and sun-warmed canvas.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

africa.are:38016.name: a Bustling Open-Air Bazaar
africa.are:38016.description: Bolts of patterned cloth hang beneath the bazaar's awnings, their loose edges stirring above the aisle. Dust softens the colors near the ground, where countless footsteps have worn a shallow track. A `wcounter`x stands beneath the hanging fabric, with space to pause beside the displays.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

africa.are:38017.name: a Bustling Open-Air Bazaar
africa.are:38017.description: Shallow trays and stacked baskets fill the shaded displays of the bazaar. The dry scent of spices lingers beneath the canvas, and bright slivers of open sky show between the awnings. A scuffed `wcounter`x borders the aisle, the wood worn smooth along the edge nearest the foot traffic.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

africa.are:38018.name: a Bustling Open-Air Bazaar
africa.are:38018.description: Small metal wares catch the light along this stretch of the open-air bazaar. Canvas roofs cast uneven shade over the stalls, while the central aisle remains dusty and well trodden. A sturdy `wcounter`x provides a stopping place among the close-packed displays.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

africa.are:38019.name: a Textiles Tent at the Heart of the Bazaar
africa.are:38019.description: Layers of woven cloth line the textiles tent, softening the framework beneath folds of muted color. Rolled rugs and hanging lengths of fabric border a clear camp center where visitors can gather. Dust settles into the weave near the ground, and the canvas overhead filters the light into a warm, subdued glow.

africa.are:38021.name: the Pyramids View Inn - Lobby
africa.are:38021.description: Pale plaster and warm wood trim frame a modest reception interior. A `wwaiting bench`x sits along one wall, leaving the center clear for arrivals within the inn's compact public space.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

africa.are:38022.name: the Cairo International Airport
africa.are:38022.description: A low decorative panel of sand-colored plaster frames the `wwaiting bench`x toward the right-hand end of the reception space. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

africa.are:38024.name: the Pyramids View Inn - Upper Floor Hallway
africa.are:38024.description: The far edge of the floor follows a low, rounded skirting finished in pale green paint. Small changes in the grain of the trim reveal where separate lengths have been fitted together. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

africa.are:38025.name: the Pyramids View Inn - Room 303
africa.are:38025.description: Rectangular panels of warm terracotta make a calm pattern behind the `wbed`x at the right-hand end. A folded blanket adds a deeper patch of color near the foot, the wool visibly coarser than the sheets. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

africa.are:38026.name: the Pyramids View Inn - Room 303 Bathroom
africa.are:38026.description: A broad panel of pale green paint backs the `wshower`x, with the remaining fittings held close to the right-hand wall. A pale towel folded over a simple rail adds the only soft texture among the washable surfaces. Reflections repeat between the polished surfaces, making the modest enclosure seem more intricate than it is.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

africa.are:38027.name: the Pyramids View Inn - Room 305
africa.are:38027.description: Rectangular panels of cream plaster make a calm pattern behind the `wbed`x at the left-hand end. A plain rug ends just short of the sleeping furniture, leaving a crescent of bare floor beside the mattress. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

africa.are:38029.description: The near end narrows around a broad structural pier faced in cream plaster. A narrow shadow lies inside the deepest joint, emphasizing the spare geometry. There is a faint mineral smell beneath the dry air, the scent of a room reduced to the materials that make it.

africa.are:38030.description: The right-hand end narrows around a broad structural pier faced in muted green paint. Fine tool strokes remain visible beneath the last layer of wall finish. The open floor makes the slightest unevenness conspicuous, a landscape of small seams and shallow shadows.

africa.are:38031.description: Near the far wall, the floor rises into a low ridge edged with smoke-blue paint. Small pinholes form an uneven line just above the height of a raised hand. Without furniture to soften the enclosure, every small sound acquires a dry little echo.

africa.are:38032.description: Two broad planes meet at an awkward angle on the near side, with dark walnut picked out along the join. An old repair has dried to a slightly different shade, revealing the shape of the patch. The quiet has an unfinished quality, as though the next ordinary use might finally give the space a character.

The building above is apparent as weight rather than a view, pressing the proportions down around the traveled floor.

asia.are:39000.name: In the Streets of Seoul
asia.are:39000.description: A narrow strip of blue-gray shale marks the left-hand boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. The details are modest but distinct, visible in the joins between maintained ground and the less-tended edges.

asia.are:39002.name: the Tunnels Underneath Kyoto
asia.are:39002.description: The far wall changes from broad blocks to smaller fitted pieces, leaving an irregular seam through the cream mineral deposits. The wall keeps a series of blunt tool marks, their direction changing across separate blocks. The narrow margins make the enclosing structure feel close, every seam and mineral stain held within easy reach.

asia.are:39003.name: the Sublevels of Kyoto
asia.are:39003.description: A narrow shelf of blue-gray shale projects from the near base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. Pale mineral fans spread beneath a deep joint, stopping short of the grittier surface below. The confined scale makes nearby details vivid while leaving the deeper enclosure difficult to judge.

asia.are:39004.name: a Subterranean HQ, Kyoto Branch
asia.are:39004.description: Heavy lower-level walls enclose a practical headquarters space. A `wcentral table`x stands among orderly working surfaces, with the close ceiling giving the room a sheltered, purposeful character.
places: central table

The table gathers the surrounding working positions around a single clear surface. Worn edges invite an elbow, and the inward-facing seats make shared work easier to discuss without calling across the room.

asia.are:39005.name: an overcrowded, isolated bunker
asia.are:39005.description: A `wbed`x sits against the far wall beneath a broad headboard framed in chalk-white wood. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. The quiet is domestic and modest, shaped by the distance between an elbow, a pillow, and a familiar wall.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

asia.are:39010.name: a path before an oriental style building
asia.are:39010.description: A low curb of green-veined rock follows the far margin of the open ground. Small stones have collected in the shallowest depression, sorted into a rough crescent. The details are modest but distinct, visible in the joins between maintained ground and the less-tended edges.

asia.are:39011.name: in the foyer of an oriental style building
asia.are:39011.description: A squared pier faced in blue-gray paint separates the `wwaiting bench`x from the near line of passage. An inset notice surface is bordered by a fine line of darker trim. The public surfaces carry a faint polish smell, with the quieter seating set just beyond the main flow.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

asia.are:39012.name: a large bedroom
asia.are:39012.description: Rectangular panels of honey-colored wood make a calm pattern behind the `wbed`x at the far end. Two differently textured pillows soften the head of the mattress; the nearer one keeps a shallow crease. Fabric takes the hard edge off sound, leaving the sleeping corner close enough for a lowered voice. Broad proportions give the central space room to breathe.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

asia.are:39013.name: a large bedroom
asia.are:39013.description: The near corner holds a `wbed`x with rounded edges, the nearby trim picking up the tones of pearl-gray paint. A plain rug ends just short of the sleeping furniture, leaving a crescent of bare floor beside the mattress. The arrangement makes rest feel private without shutting company out of the small space beside the bed. Broad proportions give the central space room to breathe.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

asia.are:39014.name: a quaint little hotel restaurant
asia.are:39014.description: The `wcorner table`x stands beside a broad decorative panel of smoke-blue paint, just off the near line of passing chairs. A small arrangement of folded cloth introduces crisp, pale triangles among the darker furniture. The small differences between settings keep the dining room from feeling like a single repeated arrangement.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

asia.are:39030.description: Close screens surround a private `wshower`x, leaving an open rectangle overhead. Pale pebbles are set into the floor around the drain, their rounded tops smoother than the rougher stone at the edges. A simple rail holds a folded towel beneath a projecting cap of wood. The bathroom offers shelter at shoulder height and openness above, with the mineral smell of the washing surface close at hand.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

asia.are:39031.name: Kudafolhudhoo, Maldives - A Private Open-Air Bathroom
asia.are:39031.description: A narrow `wshower`x stands behind staggered wooden screens, with the sky left open above the enclosure. Fine pale seams divide the darker paving, leading toward a shallow drainage channel along one side. A recessed shelf keeps a small soap dish clear of the floor. The private washing space is spare and tactile, all cool stone, close-grained wood, and a little softness in the folded linen.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

asia.are:39032.name: Kudafolhudhoo, Maldives - A Private Open-Air Bathroom
asia.are:39032.description: A curved screen gives the open-air bathroom a sheltered inner face. The `wshower`x is backed by small cream tiles, several of them subtly warmer than the surrounding glaze. Coarser stone borders the drain, and a short towel rail fits into the curve beside it. The upper edges frame the open sky, keeping the little washing enclosure connected to the air above the private fittings.
places: shower

asia.are:39043.description: The `wsofa`x sits within a shallow recess at the left-hand end, where the ceiling comes down a little lower. The upholstery has a fine sheen along the raised seams, with a heavier texture between them. The open middle makes a small movement conspicuous, while the upholstery gives the seated corner a closer scale.

Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

The arrangement leaves room to settle without making the working part of the treatment space feel crowded.
places: chaise

A padded chaise follows the length of the body, the upholstery softly creased from use. The raised end offers a comfortable place to rest a shoulder, with the treatment room's activity set slightly apart.

asia.are:39046.name: Kudafolhudhoo, Maldives - A Private Steam Room Full Of Mist
asia.are:39046.description: The `wshower`x occupies the near corner, where a change in gray tile makes the drain line easy to see. places: shower

asia.are:39049.name: Kudafolhudhoo, Maldives - Island Gym

Cardboard and handled goods lend the shop a dry, familiar smell beneath the cleaner surface finish.

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

austr.are:40004.name: Mangonui Fish Shop Cafe Seating Area
austr.are:40004.description: Simple tables and hard-wearing chairs form a casual dining space. A `wcorner table`x sits at the edge, where the practical finishes retain the unpretentious character of the fish shop.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

austr.are:40005.name: Mangonui Fish Shop
austr.are:40005.description: Washable surfaces and sturdy retail fittings give the fish shop a practical waterfront character. A `wservice counter`x occupies the customer edge, with clear flooring worn smooth where people wait.
places: service counter
The service counter has a smooth front edge and a scatter of small handling marks across the top. The customer side leaves room to lean beside a companion while taking in the room beyond.

austr.are:40008.name: an underwater Grotto
austr.are:40008.description: A small hollow lined with blue-gray shale lies beneath the left-hand water, distinct from the surrounding sediment. Soft sediment gathers at the lower edges of the submerged forms. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

austr.are:40009.name: a sleeping alcove
austr.are:40009.description: The `wbed`x lies off-center toward the right-hand side, balanced by a shallow wall recess finished in honey-colored wood. A small fabric wall hanging has an uneven lower edge, with a single thread curling away from the weave. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

austr.are:40010.name: Novamilia Estate
austr.are:40010.description: The `wsofa`x sits at a slight angle to the near wall, breaking up the straight lines of the cream plaster trim. A little shelf holds an arrangement of ordinary ornaments chosen for color rather than symmetry. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

boston.are:32000.name: dingy warehouse retrofitted into a rave
boston.are:32000.description: Exposed beams span the broad dance floor, their old industrial scars still visible above the club fittings. Heel marks cross older handling stains on the ground. A `wwatching bench`x stands against the rough warehouse walls, where the fabric carries the mingled traces of perfume and the building's stubborn concrete dust.
places: watching bench
A firm bench stands back from the activity, the seat polished along the busiest stretch. From here, companions can follow what happens in the open space without crowding it.

boston.are:32001.name: a Longliner Fishing Boat named "Filthy Oar"
boston.are:32001.description: The longliner's work-worn deck lies within a close framework of marine fittings. Salt-marked surfaces and repeated joints give the Filthy Oar a practical shape, with a open floor kept clear among the fixed structures.

boston.are:32004.name: Mandarin Oriental Hotel, Boston - Residential Suite
boston.are:32004.description: Carefully finished wood and soft textiles define a spacious hotel interior. A `wsofa`x stands apart from the quieter sleeping furniture, giving the suite distinct places for company and rest.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

boston.are:32009.name: a Studio Apartment in the Boston's North End
boston.are:32009.description: The far corner gathers a `wsofa`x and a low, oval table against a finish of pearl-gray paint. A shallow decorative bowl catches the room in a curved, imperfect reflection. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

boston.are:32010.name: the Main Bar area of a Shady Dive
boston.are:32010.description: The `wbar`x turns around the right-hand corner, giving the tavern two slightly different angles of conversation. The table legs have broad feet, giving the furniture a stubbornly stable appearance. The proportions are comfortably unceremonious, built around resting elbows rather than making an entrance. Small `wtables`x occupy the quieter margin, their tops softly marked by old cups and plates.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

boston.are:32011.name: a Backstage Area of a Dive behind Dark Curtains
boston.are:32011.description: A low bank of closed compartments follows the left-hand wall below a long surface of dark iron. A row of fixed metal hooks follows a support at a height intended for more than casual reach. The storage has a patient stillness, an arrangement waiting for the next ordinary task to require something.

boston.are:32012.name: a Dim-Lit Corridor leading to the Bathrooms
boston.are:32012.description: A narrow border of blue-gray paint frames the `wwashbasin`x along the far wall. The hard floor is divided into small squares, with wider joints marking the boundary of the wet surface. Nothing is far from reach; the room works through compact arrangements rather than spare space.
places: washbasin
The shallow basin has a rounded lip and a compact pair of fittings. A narrow ledge beside it offers room to rest a hand, with the mirror bringing the little washing space into close focus.

boston.are:32013.name: a service entrance of the Cosmopolitan Hotel in Downtown Boston
boston.are:32013.description: The `wwaiting bench`x sits beneath a shallow wall recess on the right-hand side, where the finish changes to gray tile. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The arrangement gives an arrival somewhere to pause before deciding how to become part of the room.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

boston.are:32015.name: Thirsty Mind Coffee and Wine Bar
boston.are:32015.description: Coffee and the faint fruity trace of old wine mingle around Thirsty Mind's `wservice counter`x. Small tables gather beneath warm finishes, their surfaces marked by the ghosts of earlier glasses. A `wcorner table`x sits just outside the busiest arrangement, offering a comfortable place for a conversation to outlast the first drink.
places: service counter
The service counter has a smooth front edge and a scatter of small handling marks across the top. The customer side leaves room to lean beside a companion while taking in the room beyond.
corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

boston.are:32016.name: the cozy interior of Boston Beach 'n BBQ
boston.are:32016.description: The room holds a settled smell of wood and old barbecue smoke. Sturdy dining furniture crowds the worn floor, with a `wshared table`x at the center and the marks of many meals along the edges. Coastal touches soften the robust fittings, giving the interior an easy, elbows-on-the-table warmth.
places: shared table

The substantial table brings a whole group within speaking distance. Chair backs shine from handling, and old marks survive near the edges, where meals and long conversations have softened the finish.

boston.are:32018.name: In The Lobby Of Boston Medical
boston.are:32018.description: The `wwaiting bench`x sits beneath a shallow wall recess on the left-hand side, where the finish changes to dark wood. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

boston.are:32019.name: Boston Auto Repair
boston.are:32019.description: The left-hand displays step down toward a low `wcounter`x, with dark wood tying the fittings together. A narrow mirror at the end of a display repeats the nearest rows into a deeper-looking arrangement. There is enough room for two people to compare impressions without turning the aisles into a meeting room.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

boston.are:32020.name: Boston Auto Repair - Office
boston.are:32020.description: The `wdesk`x faces the far half of the room beneath a restrained band of blue-gray paint. A narrow strip of cork makes a warmer patch among the harder office surfaces. The cleared working edge gives every meeting the same quiet starting point.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

boston.are:32021.name: An appartment in Boston
boston.are:32021.description: A broad section of smoke-blue paint frames the `wsofa`x at the left-hand end, giving the room a comfortable center. A woven throw lies in a broad fold over one arm, the fringe slightly longer on one side. Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

boston.are:32023.name: a deserted building in dire need of maintenance
boston.are:32023.description: A low bank of closed compartments follows the left-hand wall below a long surface of poured concrete. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The practical fittings leave little decorative surplus, making the small signs of handling unusually visible.

boston.are:32024.name: an ill-lit set of repurposed rooms
boston.are:32024.description: A deep structural recess breaks the far wall into a narrower bay behind the main floor. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The room smells of dry concrete and sheltered storage, with little softness among the practical surfaces.

boston.are:32025.name: a dilapidated, half-furnished caravan
boston.are:32025.description: Scuffed shelves border a narrow working space. Their edges carry chips from awkward loads, and fine dust marks corners that seldom see a hand. The room has the close, dry smell of things put aside, with a clear strip of floor keeping the stored supplies within reach. Grime and worn finishes have settled into the less-used corners.

boston.are:32026.name: an emptied-out warehouse in southside Boston Harbour
boston.are:32026.description: A deep structural recess breaks the near wall into a narrower bay behind the main floor. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The open spans make a modest sound travel farther than expected, returning it with a hollow edge.

boston.are:32027.name: a Hall of Cells
boston.are:32027.description: A broad panel of white ceramic gives the far wall a quiet focus within the otherwise open hall. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

boston.are:32028.name: a Room Designed for Courses and Lectures
boston.are:32028.description: The `wwaiting chairs`x rest in a shallow recess on the right-hand side, leaving the clinical route unobstructed. A framed abstract print offers a restrained patch of color at seated eye level. The room offers a place for company to remain nearby without becoming part of the treatment space.
places: waiting chairs
A row of practical chairs faces into the room. Their edges bear small scuffs from bags and restless hands, and the gaps between them allow a quiet exchange without leaning into the main thoroughfare.

boston.are:32029.name: an Outside Recreational Area
boston.are:32029.description: The right-hand surface changes around a broad repair edged with blue-gray shale. The immediate ground is clearest through the middle, where ordinary passage has kept the margins at bay. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

boston.are:32030.name: Friedman Hall's of Brown University
boston.are:32030.description: A shallow wall recess on the near side is framed by a generous border of sand-colored plaster. Small changes in the grain of the trim reveal where separate lengths have been fitted together. The clear passage carries sound farther than the close walls first suggest.

boston.are:32031.name: a long corridor in Friedman Hall
boston.are:32031.description: The near edge of the floor follows a low, rounded skirting finished in gray tile. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

boston.are:32032.name: the upper hallways of Friedman Hall
boston.are:32032.description: The far edge of the floor follows a low, rounded skirting finished in brushed steel. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

boston.are:32033.name: the custodian's corner in Friedman Hall
boston.are:32033.description: A long strip of blue-gray paint follows the left-hand side at shoulder height, breaking the plain wall into two proportions. Small changes in the grain of the trim reveal where separate lengths have been fitted together. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

boston.are:32034.name: the vice-chancellor's office of Friedman Hall
boston.are:32034.description: The `wdesk`x stands diagonally to the near wall, making an otherwise square office feel less formal. A small blotter marks a precise rectangle on the working surface, leaving a broad margin around it. There is room for a conversation to become private without the room itself becoming comfortable.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

boston.are:32035.name: a Senior Professor's office in Friedman Hall
boston.are:32035.description: The `wdesk`x sits beneath a low section of ceiling on the left-hand side, where brushed steel emphasizes the room's structure. The edge of a pinned paper curls forward from an otherwise tightly ordered notice panel. There is room for a conversation to become private without the room itself becoming comfortable.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

boston.are:32036.name: the staff lounge of Friedman Hall
boston.are:32036.description: The `wsofa`x sits at a slight angle to the far wall, breaking up the straight lines of the warm terracotta trim. The upholstery changes texture where a smooth outer panel meets the heavier weave of the cushions. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

boston.are:32037.name: a long corridor in Friedman Hall
boston.are:32037.description: The ceiling drops slightly toward the near wall, where sand-colored plaster picks out the change in level. boston.are:32039.name: the entrance of Friedman's Fieldhouse
boston.are:32039.description: A low decorative panel of cream enamel frames the `wwaiting bench`x toward the near end of the reception space. A shallow display recess holds a single decorative object, giving the surrounding blank surface a deliberate focus. The arrangement gives an arrival somewhere to pause before deciding how to become part of the room.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

boston.are:32041.name: the men's changing rooms
boston.are:32041.description: The left-hand storage compartments face a simple `wbench`x across a modest patch of clear floor. Small hooks repeat along the wall, their rounded ends projecting just far enough to hold clothing. The bench has a softer shine along the front edge, where countless changes of clothes have worn away the sharper finish.
places: bench

The bench offers a firm seat, the most-used stretch worn smoother than the ends. Small nicks catch along the edge. It's a straightforward place to sit shoulder to shoulder without crowding the open floor.

boston.are:32042.name: the women's changing rooms
boston.are:32042.description: The `wbench`x occupies a shallow recess on the left-hand side, leaving the central changing floor unobstructed. A shallow shelf leaves room for folded clothing above the more practical lower fittings. The bench has a softer shine along the front edge, where countless changes of clothes have worn away the sharper finish.
places: bench

The bench offers a firm seat, the most-used stretch worn smoother than the ends. Small nicks catch along the edge. It's a straightforward place to sit shoulder to shoulder without crowding the open floor.

boston.are:32043.name: the indoor sport facilities of Friedman Fieldhouse
boston.are:32043.description: A low structural edge of blue-gray paint separates the right-hand activity space from the surrounding passage. A broad panel presents a simple diagram of the activity, with the surrounding finish kept spare. The clear central space carries broad, overlapping scuffs, a faded record of movements repeated in different directions.

boston.are:32044.name: an indoor swimming pool inside of Friedman Fieldhouse
boston.are:32044.description: A hard rim traces the left-hand water, separating the basin from a narrow band of brushed steel. Pale deposits mark the line where small splashes have repeatedly dried against the hard edge. A mineral damp hangs close to the water, making the harder finishes feel cool even at a distance.

boston.are:32045.name: a work-out gym full of equipment

canada.are:35000.name: a street not too far from an isolated warehouse
canada.are:35000.description: A squared patch of cream mineral deposits interrupts the otherwise uneven right-hand surface. The ground retains a faint arc of wear where passing traffic has favored the same turn. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

canada.are:35001.name: an abandoned warehouse filled with occult items
canada.are:35001.description: The left-hand corner widens around a low loading platform edged with yellow safety paint. A narrow strip of floor has a rougher texture, giving the working surface a clear change underfoot. The room smells of dry concrete and sheltered storage, with little softness among the practical surfaces.

canada.are:35002.name: A bedroom in a Casino suite
canada.are:35002.description: Above the `wbed`x, a low section of the left-hand ceiling meets a broad strip of muted green paint. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. The quiet is domestic and modest, shaped by the distance between an elbow, a pillow, and a familiar wall.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

canada.are:35003.name: A Casino suite in Hull
canada.are:35003.description: A shallow recess faced in chalk-white wood shelters the `wsofa`x on the left-hand side. A shallow decorative bowl catches the room in a curved, imperfect reflection. Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

canada.are:35004.name: A Smoky Casino Suite in Hull
canada.are:35004.description: A `wsofa`x faces inward from the near wall, beneath a shallow decorative band of chalk-white wood. A low table has softly rounded corners and a pale inlay that follows the outer edge. The room feels intended for the part of a visit after everyone has stopped deciding where to stand.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

canada.are:35005.name: A Long, Dark Tunnel
canada.are:35005.description: A narrow shelf of slate-gray stone projects from the right-hand base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. A dark seam crosses the floor at an angle, disappearing beneath the nearest structural mass. The narrow margins make the enclosing structure feel close, every seam and mineral stain held within easy reach.

canada.are:35006.name: An Expansive Marketplace
canada.are:35006.description: The `wcounter`x makes a dogleg beside the near wall, separating a compact sales position from the browsing floor. One display groups the goods by size, creating a stepped silhouette against the backing panel. Cardboard and handled goods lend the shop a dry, familiar smell beneath the cleaner surface finish. Broad proportions give the central space room to breathe.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

canada.are:35007.name: A Black Passage
canada.are:35007.description: A band of blue-gray paint follows the far wall, turning a plain passage into a sequence of long, horizontal lines. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The clear passage carries sound farther than the close walls first suggest.

canada.are:35008.name: The Dark Workshop of the Artisan
canada.are:35008.description: Fine tool marks cover the Artisan's darkened `wworkbench`x, crossing older scars in patient, deliberate lines. Dust has settled into the deepest cuts. The surrounding stations keep a careful order, drawing attention toward the small working surfaces where something rough might, given enough time, become something exact.
places: workbench

Fine tool marks cross the stout working surface, with dust caught in the deepest cuts. The bench stands at a practical height for leaning over a piece of work, bringing careful hands and curious company together.

canada.are:35009.name: A Narrow Passage to Many Black Cells
canada.are:35009.description: A narrow bench stands against the near boundary beneath a plain surface of dark basalt. The boundaries repeat the same few hard shapes from every available angle. The bench offers a place to sit without making the confinement comfortable.

canada.are:35010.name: The Blood Baths
canada.are:35010.description: Deep red decorative surfaces surround a club interior arranged for close gatherings. A `wsofa`x rests against the wall, the dark upholstery contrasting with the open central floor.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

canada.are:35011.name: ViTech Corp- Entrance
canada.are:35011.description: The far corner steps inward around the `wwaiting bench`x, leaving the main arrival space clear. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The space balances welcome with a little institutional distance, keeping arrivals plainly in view.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

canada.are:35013.name: ViTech Corp- Lobby
canada.are:35013.description: Crisp corporate finishes frame ViTech's reception space. The broad floor reflects the careful attention given to appearances, though a few scuffs survive along the busiest route. A `wwaiting bench`x stands against the wall, offering visitors a precisely placed pause inside the company's polished, impersonal welcome.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

canada.are:35014.name: ViTech Corp- Second Floor
canada.are:35014.description: The left-hand wall steps inward around a shallow structural pier faced in white ceramic. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

canada.are:35015.name: Vitech Corp- Basement Lab
canada.are:35015.description: The building's heavy lower structure closes around ViTech's washable laboratory surfaces. Small abrasions dull the `wworkbench`x beneath a faint trace of cleaning chemicals. The room has a compact, contained precision, with the plain walls bringing every station into uncomfortable proximity with the others.
places: workbench

Fine tool marks cross the stout working surface, with dust caught in the deepest cuts. The bench stands at a practical height for leaning over a piece of work, bringing careful hands and curious company together.

canada.are:35016.name: ViTech Corp- Hallway
canada.are:35016.description: A band of brushed steel follows the right-hand wall, turning a plain passage into a sequence of long, horizontal lines. A narrow patch in the flooring crosses the usual line of travel at a diagonal. The restrained details become noticeable during a pause, then fall back into the ordinary business of passing through.

canada.are:35017.name: ViTech Corp- Conference Room: A
canada.are:35017.description: A shallow wall recess on the far side is framed by a generous border of gray tile. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

canada.are:35018.name: ViTech Corp- Conference Room: A
canada.are:35018.description: A shallow wall recess on the right-hand side is framed by a generous border of brushed steel. The upper finish has a finer texture than the more durable strip close to shoe height. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

dream.are:390000.name: the lobby of the Phantasos Hotel
dream.are:390000.description: A low decorative panel of sand-colored plaster frames the `wwaiting bench`x toward the far end of the reception space. The floor pattern shifts by half a tile near the edge, a small irregularity in an otherwise formal arrangement. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390001.name: (The Canteen) Aboard
dream.are:390001.description: Fine knife marks cloud the `wprep counter`x, overlapping older stains that scrubbing has never quite lifted. The kitchen carries a settled smell of cooking beneath a sharper trace of soap. Work surfaces hug the walls, leaving the center open for the small, repeated journeys of preparing a meal. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.
places: prep counter

Knife marks crisscross the preparation surface, fading beneath older stains. The clear edge leaves room for company to examine the work together, with the counter separating careful hands from the kitchen's busier floor.

dream.are:390002.name: a (Viewing Deck) Aboard
dream.are:390002.description: Weather has roughened the platform's exposed surfaces, picking out seams and small cracks. The open floor lies close to the supporting structure, with worn patches where people have lingered. It's a modest extension of the building, open enough for outside sounds to arrive without much interruption. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.

dream.are:390003.name: a Massive Cryopod-Filled (Laboratory) Aboard
dream.are:390003.description: The laboratory smells faintly sharp from repeatedly cleaned surfaces. Small abrasions cloud the `wworkbench`x where careful work has met stubborn materials. Stations stand apart around a clear floor, and the sparse surroundings give each stain or misplaced speck a significance it would lose in an ordinary room. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.
places: workbench

Fine tool marks cross the stout working surface, with dust caught in the deepest cuts. The bench stands at a practical height for leaning over a piece of work, bringing careful hands and curious company together.

dream.are:390004.name: a Twisting Labyrinth of (Corridors) Aboard
dream.are:390004.description: A vertical seam divides the far finish into two unequal panels of pale green paint. One broad panel is set back just far enough to catch a thin border of shadow. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.

dream.are:390005.name: The Dreamheart
dream.are:390005.description: The dream folds inward around a `cpale, wavering center`x. Half-formed colors gather there and slip apart, like memories losing the names of the people in them. Nothing quite becomes a wall or a horizon. It's the still point of an unfinished thought, with all the surrounding strangeness leaning toward it.

dream.are:390007.name: Lair of the Dragon
dream.are:390007.description: The far wall opens into a shallow natural hollow lined with blue-gray shale. A rounded pocket holds finer sediment than the rough ground surrounding it. The rock gives sound an uneven return, sometimes close and sometimes swallowed by the surrounding folds.

dream.are:390012.name: an ornate foyer
dream.are:390012.description: A squared pier faced in cream enamel separates the `wwaiting bench`x from the left-hand line of passage. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. A few carefully placed fittings do most of the work, leaving the room open enough to take in at a glance.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390016.name: dazzled by a crystalline fountain
dream.are:390016.description: The near ceiling steps down above a squared structural pier faced in gray tile. The floor pattern shifts by a small fraction at an old join, making the repair easier to feel with the eye than to measure. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

dream.are:390017.name: a gleaming glass and iron-wrought entryway
dream.are:390017.description: The busiest line across the reception floor has been worn to a dull sheen. A `wwaiting bench`x rests against the wall, with seats softened by brief visits and long delays. The clear center gives arrivals a moment to take in the room before joining anyone already settled along the edge. Glass panels give the surrounding structure a reflective, layered appearance.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390028.name: The Reception Area
dream.are:390028.description: The far corner steps inward around the `wwaiting bench`x, leaving the main arrival space clear. A narrow directory panel is arranged in careful rows, with slightly different shades behind the oldest labels. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390029.name: The Truancy Officer's Office
dream.are:390029.description: The `wdesk`x sits beneath a low section of ceiling on the near side, where cream enamel emphasizes the room's structure. A plain clock face sits among the wall fittings, modest enough to become conspicuous only during a pause. The arrangement sets a clear distance between host and visitor, close enough for courtesy to carry some weight.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390030.name: A Hallway Between Reception and The Library
dream.are:390030.description: The right-hand corner opens around the `wreading table`x, where lower shelving gives way to warm terracotta. The nearest shelf has adjustable slots along the uprights, a practical detail beneath the more substantial woodwork. The shelving breaks up sound, giving a lowered conversation the feeling of a small clearing among books.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

dream.are:390031.name: Featureless Bunks in the (Living Quarters) Aboard
dream.are:390031.description: Bare surfaces expose every scrape and uneven patch in this unfinished space. Fine dust settles along the floor's margins, beyond the clearest stretch of standing room. With no furnishings to break it up, the enclosure gives a single voice an unexpectedly hollow sound. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.

dream.are:390035.name: the Grotesque Tableau of an (Operating Theater) Aboard
dream.are:390035.description: A narrow `wtreatment table`x occupies a harshly lit pocket between ribbed bulkheads. The washable surface is unnervingly pale beside the darker housings and the deep red-brown traces that survive in their seams. A circular fitting hangs over the working position, turning the table into the center of an ugly little tableau. Metal, disinfectant, and enclosed shipboard air make the room feel meticulously prepared for something no comfort could soften.
places: treatment table
Firm padding covers a narrow, easily cleaned table. The raised surface leaves room to stand close on either side, keeping patient and attendant within quiet speaking distance.

dream.are:390039.name: the tunnels beneath the Fighting Pit
dream.are:390039.description: A narrow shelf of dark basalt projects from the right-hand base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. Fine sediment marks a shallow depression where water has gathered and receded. The confined scale makes nearby details vivid while leaving the deeper enclosure difficult to judge.

dream.are:390041.name: a cell beneath the Fighting Pit
dream.are:390041.description: A narrow bench stands against the far boundary beneath a plain surface of green-veined rock. The floor has a smoother wear along the shortest route between the boundaries. There is little here to distract an eye; the room makes the same edges available again and again.

dream.are:390049.name: The Royal Palace
dream.are:390049.description: A shallow recess faced in chalk-white wood shelters the `wsofa`x on the right-hand side. A little shelf holds an arrangement of ordinary ornaments chosen for color rather than symmetry. The seats turn attention toward company, leaving the surrounding details to be noticed between exchanges.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390063.name: the Main Floor of the Stepford Sanitarium
dream.are:390063.description: Pale surfaces meet in immaculate lines across the sanitarium's reception space. Waiting chairs stand at almost painfully regular intervals, with no casual clutter to break the arrangement. The air smells scrub`wbed`x and faintly medicinal. It's a tidy welcome, made unsettling by the sense that even a crooked chair would draw attention.
places: waiting chairs
A row of practical chairs faces into the room. Their edges bear small scuffs from bags and restless hands, and the gaps between them allow a quiet exchange without leaning into the main thoroughfare.
bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390064.name: the Basement of the Stepford Sanitarium
dream.are:390064.description: A narrow shelf of green-veined rock projects from the far base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. Pale mineral fans spread beneath a deep joint, stopping short of the grittier surface below. The sheltered surfaces seem to keep the memory of moisture long after the visible traces have faded.

dream.are:390065.name: the Steam Tunnels under Main Street
dream.are:390065.description: The near surface changes around a broad repair edged with green-veined rock. Small stones have collected in the shallowest depression, sorted into a rough crescent. This is ground meant to be crossed or briefly paused upon, shaped by ordinary use rather than furnishings.

dream.are:390066.name: the Basement of a Perfect Single-Family Home

The lower surfaces have a smoother wear than the rough material above shoulder height. The building above is apparent as weight rather than a view, pressing the proportions down around the traveled floor.

Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390069.name: P2: Kismet

dream.are:390072.name: the Grand Foyer

Broad proportions give the central space room to breathe.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390074.name: the Dining Room

The chair backs use a simple curved motif that repeats, at a smaller scale, along the nearest table edge. Nothing asks a group to hurry; even the spaces around the chairs seem measured for people lingering.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

dream.are:390075.name: the Smoking Lounge
dream.are:390075.description: A broad section of cream plaster frames the `wsofa`x at the near end, giving the room a comfortable center. places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390081.name: a west-facing Guest Suite

dream.are:390118.name: Inside the Mothballed (Freighter 'Neomi') Aboard
dream.are:390118.description: The left-hand shell curves close above the passenger space, leaving little unused room between the fitted surfaces. The interior lining has a subtle woven pattern that becomes visible at close range. The interior has a practical compactness, turning the needs of the vessel into the proportions of the room. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

A framed diagram uses hairline rules and small labels, rewarding a closer look without dominating the office. There is room for a conversation to become private without the room itself becoming comfortable.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390345.name: Office Three
dream.are:390345.description: A shallow alcove of dark wood backs the `wdesk`x at the right-hand end. A plain clock face sits among the wall fittings, modest enough to become conspicuous only during a pause. The arrangement sets a clear distance between host and visitor, close enough for courtesy to carry some weight.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390347.name: A Massive Gymnasium (New Sparta)
dream.are:390347.description: The far fittings follow the lines of the playing surface, turning the room's proportions toward the activity. Repeated movement has left arcs rather than straight tracks across the busiest part of the surface. The room has the practical wear of effort repeated for enjoyment as much as discipline.

dream.are:390348.name: Wharfside - Inside Mickey's Pub
dream.are:390348.description: A squared return gives the `wbar`x a sheltered end on the near side, framed in chalk-white wood. A framed piece of local-looking memorabilia occupies a place of honor disproportionate to the size of the frame. The room offers a choice between the shared counter and the smaller company gathered around a table. Small `wtables`x occupy the quieter margin, their tops softly marked by old cups and plates.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390352.name: Reception Lobby
dream.are:390352.description: The `wwaiting bench`x sits beneath a shallow wall recess on the right-hand side, where the finish changes to dark wood. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390353.name: The Porch of Four Doors
dream.are:390353.description: The right-hand structure narrows around a squared support, leaving the standing surface open to the surrounding air. Small stones have collected in the shallowest depression, sorted into a rough crescent. The open structure frames a place to pause without turning the platform into an enclosed room.

dream.are:390372.name: Long Hallway
dream.are:390372.description: A vertical seam divides the far finish into two unequal panels of white ceramic. A narrow patch in the flooring crosses the usual line of travel at a diagonal. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

dream.are:390373.name: South Bedroom
dream.are:390373.description: The left-hand corner holds a `wbed`x with rounded edges, the nearby trim picking up the tones of cream plaster. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390374.name: North Bedroom
dream.are:390374.description: A `wbed`x sits against the near wall beneath a broad headboard framed in pearl-gray paint. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. The arrangement makes rest feel private without shutting company out of the small space beside the bed.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390375.name: Hotel Bar
dream.are:390375.description: The near `wtables`x rest below a broad decorative panel of warm terracotta, a little removed from the `wbar`x. The counter has a softly rounded lip, worn to a different sheen from the wider working surface. There is a settled sociability to the place, visible in the surfaces shaped by years of people lingering.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390376.name: Hotel Dining Room
dream.are:390376.description: The `wcorner table`x stands beside a broad decorative panel of pearl-gray paint, just off the left-hand line of passing chairs. A small arrangement of folded cloth introduces crisp, pale triangles among the darker furniture. The scale favors a long visit, with the surrounding details left to fill comfortable pauses.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

dream.are:390377.name: Hotel Lounge
dream.are:390377.description: A broad section of pearl-gray paint frames the `wsofa`x at the near end, giving the room a comfortable center. The upholstery changes texture where a smooth outer panel meets the heavier weave of the cushions. The seats turn attention toward company, leaving the surrounding details to be noticed between exchanges.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390380.name: The Goblin Market's Library
dream.are:390380.description: Books crowd the Goblin Market's shelves in mismatched ranks. Some bindings look waxy, others fibrous; the gaps between them carry a dry, peculiar smell that ordinary paper doesn't quite explain. A `wreading table`x makes a small island of order among the volumes, though even the straightest stacks lean a little toward their neighbors.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

dream.are:390381.name: At World's End: Misty Cove
dream.are:390381.description: The far beach gathers into a low hollow where rust-colored sandstone has collected among the sand. Fine grains have settled into the sheltered side of a small stone, making a delicate fan. The shore is made of countless small edges worn soft, each one a little different from the next.

dream.are:390382.name: High Seas: Southeastern Waters
dream.are:390382.description: The left-hand water gathers above an uneven shelf of blue-gray shale, breaking the bottom into overlapping planes. The nearer water keeps a clearer color than the deeper reach beyond it. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

dream.are:390383.name: High Seas: Eastern Waters
dream.are:390383.description: Toward the near, the water deepens over a submerged band of chalky stone. The surface breaks reflections into small, uneven pieces that never settle into a single picture. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

dream.are:390384.name: High Seas: Northeastern Waters
dream.are:390384.description: The left-hand water gathers above an uneven shelf of slate-gray stone, breaking the bottom into overlapping planes. Soft sediment gathers at the lower edges of the submerged forms. The surrounding water lends everything a softened depth, with no dry standing place within the immediate reach.

dream.are:390385.name: High Seas: Northern Waters
dream.are:390385.description: The near water gathers above an uneven shelf of cream mineral deposits, breaking the bottom into overlapping planes. The overlap of water and submerged ground makes distances difficult to judge by sight alone. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

dream.are:390386.name: High Seas: Central Waters
dream.are:390386.description: A pale shape of blue-gray shale interrupts the far depths before the surrounding water softens the outline. Fine particles hang between the nearer shapes, blurring the smallest details before the larger outlines disappear. The water remains the defining feature, gathering the smaller contours into one continuous expanse.

dream.are:390387.name: High Seas: Southern Waters
dream.are:390387.description: Toward the right-hand, the water deepens over a submerged band of rust-colored sandstone. Soft sediment gathers at the lower edges of the submerged forms. The open water gives a view without offering the certainty of firm ground beneath it.

dream.are:390388.name: High Seas: Southwestern Waters
dream.are:390388.description: The far bed slopes away from a low rise of pale limestone, leaving a darker reach beyond it. The surface breaks reflections into small, uneven pieces that never settle into a single picture. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

dream.are:390389.name: High Seas: Western Waters
dream.are:390389.description: Toward the left-hand, the water deepens over a submerged band of rust-colored sandstone. Small ridges on the bottom remain visible until a change in the surface interrupts the view. The open water gives a view without offering the certainty of firm ground beneath it.

dream.are:390390.name: High Seas: Northwestern Waters
dream.are:390390.description: The right-hand water gathers above an uneven shelf of rust-colored sandstone, breaking the bottom into overlapping planes. Soft sediment gathers at the lower edges of the submerged forms. The open water gives a view without offering the certainty of firm ground beneath it.

dream.are:390391.name: Nassau Harbor
dream.are:390391.description: Heavy dockside timber and salt-worn surfaces define the harbor setting. The open floor has the close, practical scale of a waterfront landing, surrounded by the textures of maritime use.

dream.are:390392.name: Harbor Del Sol
dream.are:390392.description: Pale, salt-marked masonry meets worn waterfront surfaces. The harbor's gathering space feels broad beside the heavier edges of the built surroundings.

dream.are:390393.name: King's Town Harbor
dream.are:390393.description: Formal stone edging and work-worn timber meet at the harbor. Their contrasting materials give the waterfront the character of both a civic boundary and a working landing.

dream.are:390394.name: Skull Rock Lagoon
dream.are:390394.description: A pale shape of rust-colored sandstone interrupts the right-hand depths before the surrounding water softens the outline. Soft sediment gathers at the lower edges of the submerged forms. The surrounding water lends everything a softened depth, with no dry standing place within the immediate reach.

dream.are:390395.name: Cyclops Island: The Shore
dream.are:390395.description: The right-hand beach gathers into a low hollow where cream mineral deposits has collected among the sand. Older impressions have softened at the edges until they look like small changes in the surface rather than tracks. The exposed shore has little enclosure, leaving the interest in small textures close to the ground.

dream.are:390396.name: Trader's Bizaar
dream.are:390396.description: The right-hand displays step down toward a low `wcounter`x, with brushed steel tying the fittings together. Fine wire dividers keep neighboring goods apart without hiding their outlines. The arrangement makes browsing feel unhurried, with the sales position always easy to find again.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

dream.are:390397.name: A small footpath
dream.are:390397.description: A narrow path traces the ground, pressed smooth through the middle and crumbling at the edges. Tiny stones and broken stems collect in the shallow hollows. It's an unassuming route, marked less by careful construction than by the steady insistence of people passing through. The close proportions leave little spare space between the room's edges.

dream.are:390398.name: Nassau Well
dream.are:390398.description: A narrow shelf of dark basalt projects from the far base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. A dark seam crosses the floor at an angle, disappearing beneath the nearest structural mass. The sheltered surfaces seem to keep the memory of moisture long after the visible traces have faded.

dream.are:390399.name: Northern Sprawl
dream.are:390399.description: The left-hand wall opens into a shallow natural hollow lined with rust-colored sandstone. The nearest fracture exposes a fresher color beneath the weathered outer skin. The rock gives sound an uneven return, sometimes close and sometimes swallowed by the surrounding folds.

dream.are:390400.name: The Poisoned Frog
dream.are:390400.description: Rough stone walls shelter a close, eccentric interior. Green decorative accents interrupt the darker surfaces, while a pair of `wcorner seats`x gives the enclosure an intimate center.
places: corner seats
These seats tuck into a quieter corner, angled toward one another. The fabric is softened by use, and the close arrangement makes it easy to lower a voice without losing sight of the room.

dream.are:390407.name: Inside the Beacon of Lost Souls
dream.are:390407.description: The left-hand wall changes from broad blocks to smaller fitted pieces, leaving an irregular seam through the rust-colored sandstone. A dark seam crosses the floor at an angle, disappearing beneath the nearest structural mass. The confined scale makes nearby details vivid while leaving the deeper enclosure difficult to judge.

dream.are:390408.name: Smoky Back Room
dream.are:390408.description: A deep storage recess breaks the right-hand wall, with poured concrete covering the heavier lower fittings. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The practical fittings leave little decorative surplus, making the small signs of handling unusually visible.

dream.are:390414.name: The Throne Room of Castle Hearts
dream.are:390414.description: Substantial walls rise around a broad central floor. Age shows in the joints and the gently softened edges of the grander fittings. The scale lends a formal weight to anyone standing here, making an ordinary crossing of the room feel briefly like an entrance before an audience. Heart motifs recur in exaggerated fittings, lending Castle Hearts the sugary grandeur of a storybook drawn slightly out of scale.

dream.are:390424.name: Welcome to March Manor
dream.are:390424.description: Cultivated ground gathers around the manor's substantial structure. The ordered edges and exaggerated proportions give the approach a storybook formality.

dream.are:390427.name: Welcome to Hatter House

A woven throw lies in a broad fold over one arm, the fringe slightly longer on one side. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390430.name: The Great Hall of the Duchess' Manor
dream.are:390430.description: A long strip of gray tile follows the near side at shoulder height, breaking the plain wall into two proportions. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

dream.are:390431.name: The Pepper-Filled Kitchen of the Duchess' Manor

Knife marks crisscross the preparation surface, fading beneath older stains. The clear edge leaves room for company to examine the work together, with the counter separating careful hands from the kitchen's busier floor.

The ordinary objects make the office feel occupied by a routine even when nobody is carrying it out. Austere finishes meet in disciplined lines, giving New Hope the carefully maintained appearance of a settlement with rules for everything.

Chairs gather around the long tabletop, their spacing keeping each face in view. Faint rings interrupt the finish. Leaning forward closes the distance across the table; sitting back leaves a more formal gap.
