dream.are:390498.name: the Bar in the ^Lodge^
dream.are:390498.description: The right-hand `wtables`x rest below a broad decorative panel of pearl-gray paint, a little removed from the `wbar`x. A narrow carved border uses a pattern of leaves, interrupted where two lengths of trim meet. The proportions are comfortably unceremonious, built around resting elbows rather than making an entrance.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390539.name: The White Oak Technical Institute
dream.are:390539.description: Orderly institutional finishes frame a broad reception area. Pale surfaces and precisely spaced `wwaiting chairs`x give White Oak's interior the deliberate, controlled character.
places: waiting chairs
A row of practical chairs faces into the room. Their edges bear small scuffs from bags and restless hands, and the gaps between them allow a quiet exchange without leaning into the main thoroughfare.

dream.are:390548.name: Ritual Chamber
dream.are:390548.description: The right-hand end is arranged around a recessed devotional panel framed in green-veined rock. The surrounding decoration leaves deliberate areas of plain surface between the more intricate work. The heavier materials give the devotional details a quiet permanence.

dream.are:390549.name: Manor Bedroom
dream.are:390549.description: A narrow band of smoke-blue paint follows the near wall behind the `wbed`x, giving the sleeping corner a quiet emphasis. The bedding has a narrow stitched border that repeats in the cloth covering a small bedside surface. The quiet is domestic and modest, shaped by the distance between an elbow, a pillow, and a familiar wall.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390550.name: Manor Kitchen
dream.are:390550.description: A deep working recess on the near side contains the `wprep counter`x and a neat strip of muted green paint. A row of hooks follows the underside of a shelf, each casting a small curved shadow against the backing. A trace of earlier cooking remains beneath the clean surfaces, a warmer smell than the room's hard finishes suggest.
places: prep counter

Knife marks crisscross the preparation surface, fading beneath older stains. The clear edge leaves room for company to examine the work together, with the counter separating careful hands from the kitchen's busier floor.

dream.are:390551.name: Cobblestone Avenue
dream.are:390551.description: The far edge broadens beside a shallow drainage seam cut through green-veined rock. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

dream.are:390552.name: King's Town Courtyard
dream.are:390552.description: A narrow strip of pale limestone marks the near boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. This is ground meant to be crossed or briefly paused upon, shaped by ordinary use rather than furnishings.

dream.are:390553.name: Papal Street
dream.are:390553.description: The far edge broadens beside a shallow drainage seam cut through pale limestone. An older stain has faded to a soft outline, most distinct where the surrounding ground changes texture. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

dream.are:390554.name: Manor Avenue
dream.are:390554.description: The near edge broadens beside a shallow drainage seam cut through pale limestone. An older stain has faded to a soft outline, most distinct where the surrounding ground changes texture. The details are modest but distinct, visible in the joins between maintained ground and the less-tended edges.

dream.are:390555.name: Discreet Cobblestone Avenue
dream.are:390555.description: A narrow strip of dark basalt marks the right-hand boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. The exposed surfaces carry a small history of repairs, each one aging a little differently from the last.

dream.are:390556.name: Church of Croix
dream.are:390556.description: The near end is arranged around a recessed devotional panel framed in blue-gray shale. Small traces of old wax sit in the deepest joints beneath the ceremonial fittings. The spare arrangement gives each carved edge a patient weight, allowing the smallest detail to hold the eye.

dream.are:390557.name: Papal Office
dream.are:390557.description: The `wdesk`x stands diagonally to the left-hand wall, making an otherwise square office feel less formal. A narrow strip of cork makes a warmer patch among the harder office surfaces. The cleared working edge gives every meeting the same quiet starting point.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390558.name: Confession Booth
dream.are:390558.description: The right-hand floor opens before a raised devotional surface backed by carefully fitted rust-colored sandstone. Small traces of old wax sit in the deepest joints beneath the ceremonial fittings. The heavier materials give the devotional details a quiet permanence.

dream.are:390559.name: A jungle passage
dream.are:390559.description: The far edge of the floor follows a low, rounded skirting finished in sand-colored plaster. The upper finish has a finer texture than the more durable strip close to shoe height. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

dream.are:390560.name: A Side Path
dream.are:390560.description: A narrow strip of green-veined rock marks the near boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. A small tuft of stubborn growth has found a pocket between two differently finished surfaces. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

dream.are:390561.name: Smuggler's Den
dream.are:390561.description: A broad section of dark walnut frames the `wsofa`x at the right-hand end, giving the room a comfortable center. A low table has softly rounded corners and a pale inlay that follows the outer edge. The seats turn attention toward company, leaving the surrounding details to be noticed between exchanges.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390562.name: The Gazeebo
dream.are:390562.description: A broad span of pale limestone carries the far footing, with the supporting joints exposed beneath the edge. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. The surrounding air remains part of the space, with the nearest structure providing scale rather than enclosure.

dream.are:390563.name: Gypsy Camp
dream.are:390563.description: The right-hand camp structure is divided by a simple hanging screen, leaving the central floor clear. A fastening has been wrapped several times around the nearest support, leaving a compact knot against the rough material. The shelter offers a human-sized pause within a larger setting, held together by ordinary practical choices.

dream.are:390564.name: Kraken's Lair: Watery depths
dream.are:390564.description: A folded ridge of pale limestone rises from the right-hand floor and disappears into the enclosing rock. A branching stain follows a hidden route through the rock before spreading into a wider patch. The cave smells of cool stone and sheltered grit, with no domestic softness to break the enclosure.

dream.are:390565.name: The Butcher's Block
dream.are:390565.description: The left-hand ceiling lowers around a rounded projection, the surface layered like folded blue-gray shale. Small mineral beads cling beneath an overhang, their pale edges distinct against the darker stone. The natural shapes remain stubbornly indifferent to a human-sized sense of comfort or symmetry.

dream.are:390567.name: Square del Sol
dream.are:390567.description: The left-hand ceiling lowers around a rounded projection, the surface layered like folded chalky stone. The floor holds a fan of broken chips, grading from blunt fragments to fine grit. The natural shapes remain stubbornly indifferent to a human-sized sense of comfort or symmetry.

dream.are:390568.name: A shady alley
dream.are:390568.description: The near edge broadens beside a shallow drainage seam cut through pale limestone. Small stones have collected in the shallowest depression, sorted into a rough crescent. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

dream.are:390569.name: The Bordello
dream.are:390569.description: A folded ridge of chalky stone rises from the right-hand floor and disappears into the enclosing rock. The nearest fracture exposes a fresher color beneath the weathered outer skin. The cave smells of cool stone and sheltered grit, with no domestic softness to break the enclosure.

dream.are:390570.name: A small private chamber
dream.are:390570.description: Above the `wbed`x, a low section of the left-hand ceiling meets a broad strip of warm terracotta. A small fabric wall hanging has an uneven lower edge, with a single thread curling away from the weave. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays. The close proportions leave little spare space between the room's edges.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390571.name: A second private chamber
dream.are:390571.description: The `wbed`x lies off-center toward the right-hand side, balanced by a shallow wall recess finished in warm terracotta. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390572.name: A third private chamber
dream.are:390572.description: Rectangular panels of pearl-gray paint make a calm pattern behind the `wbed`x at the right-hand end. Two differently textured pillows soften the head of the mattress; the nearer one keeps a shallow crease. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390573.name: Bell Tower
dream.are:390573.description: The right-hand treads meet a low structural return faced in brushed steel. The nearest treads have gently rounded noses, with narrower dark lines where the risers meet them. The enclosure gives each small sound a short, climbing echo.

dream.are:390574.name: A broad paved street
dream.are:390574.description: A narrow strip of chalky stone marks the near boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. An older stain has faded to a soft outline, most distinct where the surrounding ground changes texture. The exposed surfaces carry a small history of repairs, each one aging a little differently from the last.

dream.are:390575.name: A broadly paved street
dream.are:390575.description: The left-hand margin rises gently against a low retaining edge of blue-gray shale. The exposed edges are rounded more heavily on one side than the other. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

dream.are:390576.name: Spanish Manor House
dream.are:390576.description: The far corner gathers a `wsofa`x and a low, oval table against a finish of chalk-white wood. A shallow decorative bowl catches the room in a curved, imperfect reflection. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390577.name: King's Town Mansion
dream.are:390577.description: Heavy stone surfaces enclose a formal interior. Carefully finished wood relieves the masonry around a central gathering space, giving the mansion a weighty domestic grandeur.

dream.are:390578.name: Mansion Bedroom
dream.are:390578.description: Above the `wbed`x, a low section of the far ceiling meets a broad strip of dark walnut. The bedding has a narrow stitched border that repeats in the cloth covering a small bedside surface. Fabric takes the hard edge off sound, leaving the sleeping corner close enough for a lowered voice.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390579.name: Mansion Study
dream.are:390579.description: The `wdesk`x faces the near half of the room beneath a restrained band of sand-colored plaster. A document tray has been turned slightly away from the visitor, presenting the neat backs of stacked folders. The arrangement sets a clear distance between host and visitor, close enough for courtesy to carry some weight.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390580.name: The Whispering Eye
dream.are:390580.description: Close stone surfaces gather around a small, contemplative interior. Eye-shaped decorative marks recur at the edges, directing attention toward a quiet central space.

dream.are:390587.name: The Forsaken Plaza
dream.are:390587.description: A low curb of pale limestone follows the near margin of the open ground. A small tuft of stubborn growth has found a pocket between two differently finished surfaces. Nothing closes the space overhead; the surrounding forms frame the ground without turning it into an interior.

dream.are:390588.name: The Market
dream.are:390588.description: The `wcounter`x sits beneath a shallow display recess framed in pale green paint on the far side. A small handwritten-looking label introduces an uneven note among otherwise regular printed cards. Cardboard and handled goods lend the shop a dry, familiar smell beneath the cleaner surface finish.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

dream.are:390591.name: The Yellow Spire
dream.are:390591.description: A reinforced wall panel of ribbed steel gives the left-hand end a blunt, practical finish. A row of fixed metal hooks follows a support at a height intended for more than casual reach. The clear bays show their purpose through structure rather than decoration.

dream.are:390593.name: Library of Kings
dream.are:390593.description: A break in the right-hand shelves leaves room for the `wreading table`x, backed by a panel of warm terracotta. The nearest shelf has adjustable slots along the uprights, a practical detail beneath the more substantial woodwork. The room encourages the eye to settle on one thing at a time, despite the accumulation surrounding it.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

dream.are:390594.name: The Blue Spire
dream.are:390594.description: A broad storage bay opens along the left-hand wall beneath structural spans of poured concrete. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The clear center preserves the wide turning arcs of old loads, with the finest dust caught safely beneath the shelving.

dream.are:390595.name: The Inside of March Manor & Hatter House
dream.are:390595.description: A broad section of honey-colored wood frames the `wsofa`x at the far end, giving the room a comfortable center. A low table has softly rounded corners and a pale inlay that follows the outer edge. There is an easy domestic scale here: nothing grander than a shared table edge and a place to settle.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390611.name: A Rocky Platform Within The Underwater Cave System
dream.are:390611.description: A repeated line of blue-gray shale traces the left-hand boundary of the raised surface. Fine grit gathers in a branching crack, leaving the harder surface clear between the lines. There is little to furnish here; the raised span and the view beyond it give the place a sufficient character.

dream.are:390612.name: Coffee Shop
dream.are:390612.description: A low display shelf of cream plaster backs the `wcounter`x at the right-hand end of the cafe. The counter trim has a subtle ripple in the finish, visible where the surface catches a reflection. The arrangements leave room for both sociable company and someone content to watch the room from a small table. Small `wtables`x occupy the quieter margin, their tops softly marked by old cups and plates.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390619.name: Hotel Antlers - Room 101
dream.are:390619.description: A `wbed`x sits against the near wall beneath a broad headboard framed in chalk-white wood. A plain rug ends just short of the sleeping furniture, leaving a crescent of bare floor beside the mattress. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390621.name: St. Ignatius
dream.are:390621.description: Substantial walls enclose a restrained interior. Long structural lines direct attention toward the clear center, giving the room a solemn, institutional scale.

dream.are:390626.name: Castle Black
dream.are:390626.description: The far floor widens around a low projection from the wall, making the open interior slightly asymmetrical. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

dream.are:390637.name: The Throne Room
dream.are:390637.description: A broad panel of brushed steel gives the far wall a quiet focus within the otherwise open hall. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

dream.are:390649.name: The Bridge
dream.are:390649.description: A broad span of pale limestone carries the far footing, with the supporting joints exposed beneath the edge. Small stones have collected in the shallowest depression, sorted into a rough crescent. The visible supports keep the difference between this footing and ordinary ground apparent.

dream.are:390650.name: Mess Hall
dream.are:390650.description: A deep working recess on the right-hand side contains the `wprep counter`x and a neat strip of warm terracotta. The lower storage has generous handles set far enough apart for an elbow to pass between them. The room makes a practical kind of welcome, measured in elbow room and surfaces within reach.
places: prep counter

Knife marks crisscross the preparation surface, fading beneath older stains. The clear edge leaves room for company to examine the work together, with the counter separating careful hands from the kitchen's busier floor.

dream.are:390651.name: Officers Quarters
dream.are:390651.description: A broad panel of white ceramic frames the working side of the `wdesk`x along the right-hand wall. A plain clock face sits among the wall fittings, modest enough to become conspicuous only during a pause. The ordinary objects make the office feel occupied by a routine even when nobody is carrying it out.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

dream.are:390652.name: Crew Quarters
dream.are:390652.description: A low structural arch of dark basalt draws the right-hand wall close to the passage. A dark seam crosses the floor at an angle, disappearing beneath the nearest structural mass. The building above is apparent as weight rather than a view, pressing the proportions down around the traveled floor.

dream.are:390653.name: Engine Room
dream.are:390653.description: A narrow shelf of blue-gray shale projects from the near base of the wall, just above the traveled ground. A dark seam crosses the floor at an angle, disappearing beneath the nearest structural mass. The building above is apparent as weight rather than a view, pressing the proportions down around the traveled floor.

dream.are:390654.name: Fighter Bay
dream.are:390654.description: A pale shape of chalky stone interrupts the near depths before the surrounding water softens the outline. The overlap of water and submerged ground makes distances difficult to judge by sight alone. Even the clearest shape seems held at a remove by the layers between it and the surface.

dream.are:390655.name: Shooting Range
dream.are:390655.description: The far playing space is framed by a broad strip of sand-colored plaster, keeping the central activity area clear. The floor changes texture just beyond the main playing surface, making the limit apparent underfoot. The clear central space carries broad, overlapping scuffs, a faded record of movements repeated in different directions.

dream.are:390656.name: Dojo
dream.are:390656.description: The left-hand playing space is framed by a broad strip of pale green paint, keeping the central activity area clear. The boundary markings change direction around a neatly fitted corner. The room has the practical wear of effort repeated for enjoyment as much as discipline.

dream.are:390657.name: In the Foyer of Gravesend Public Library
dream.are:390657.description: A squared pier faced in cream enamel separates the `wwaiting bench`x from the near line of passage. An inset notice surface is bordered by a fine line of darker trim. The space balances welcome with a little institutional distance, keeping arrivals plainly in view.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390658.name: In the Front Lobby at Town Hall
dream.are:390658.description: The left-hand floor widens beside the `wwaiting bench`x, making a small pause within the larger circulation space. A mat with a simple border makes a darker rectangle along the busiest route across the floor. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

dream.are:390659.name: a private back room
dream.are:390659.description: A low bank of closed compartments follows the far wall below a long surface of blackened brick. A narrow strip of floor has a rougher texture, giving the working surface a clear change underfoot. The shelves have the dry smell of old packaging, strongest where their closely fitted backs meet the wall.

dream.are:390660.name: Passing through the Breach
dream.are:390660.description: The enclosing surfaces lose their ordinary continuity around a wavering central space. Edges seem displaced rather than broken, giving the Breach the unsettling appearance of two places failing to align.

dream.are:390661.name: Guild Square (Malifaux)
dream.are:390661.description: The `wcounter`x faces small `wtables`x from the near side, with warm terracotta warming the fittings behind it. A small chalkboard panel carries the dust of earlier lettering along the lower edge. The close furniture makes it easy for a short stop to become a longer conversation.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390662.name: Quarantine Zone (Malifaux)
dream.are:390662.description: Neglected built surfaces crowd a restricted patch of urban ground. Rough barriers and accumulated debris give the district a compressed, unwelcoming character.

dream.are:390663.name: Ancient Sewers (Malifaux)
dream.are:390663.description: A shallow drainage recess follows the left-hand floor beside a wall of rust-colored sandstone. The wall keeps a series of blunt tool marks, their direction changing across separate blocks. The air carries a cool mineral damp, and sounds return with the close insistence of an enclosed passage.

dream.are:390664.name: The Hanging Tree (Malifaux)
dream.are:390664.description: A heavy, contorted tree dominates the ground. The thick limbs project over a clear patch of earth, their worn shapes giving the landmark a grim, deliberate presence.

dream.are:390665.name: Slums (Malifaux)
dream.are:390665.description: Close, patched structures crowd uneven ground. Different repairs overlap across the surfaces, giving the settlement a dense texture of necessity and prolonged wear.

dream.are:390666.name: The Last Light Tavern (Malifaux)
dream.are:390666.description: The `wbar`x follows the left-hand wall beneath substantial trim of chalk-white wood, with `wtables`x set farther back. The counter has a softly rounded lip, worn to a different sheen from the wider working surface. Wood polish and old beer mingle in the close air, the familiar smell of conversations that ran beyond one drink.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390667.name: Aboard the Train (Train)
dream.are:390667.description: The near compartment narrows around a broad structural rib faced in blue-gray paint. A pale repair stitch crosses one short section of the upholstery without matching the original spacing. The repeating ribs make the structure feel near even where the passage remains clear. Ribbed bulkheads and inset panels crowd the shipboard space, their seams holding the faint, stubborn smell of enclosed travel.

dream.are:390668.name: Town Square (Mining Town 42)
dream.are:390668.description: The right-hand wall gathers the `wcounter`x beneath a broad panel of pearl-gray paint, leaving the `wtables`x in a looser arrangement. Cup-shaped marks form pale crescents beneath the table finish, overlapping the grain like incomplete rings. The arrangements leave room for both sociable company and someone content to watch the room from a small table.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

dream.are:390669.name: Soulstone Mine (Mining Town 42)
dream.are:390669.description: A shelf of chalky stone breaks the left-hand slope, with loose fragments gathered beneath the lip. The floor holds a fan of broken chips, grading from blunt fragments to fine grit. The rock gives sound an uneven return, sometimes close and sometimes swallowed by the surrounding folds.

dream.are:390670.name: Swampy bog (Bayou)
dream.are:390670.description: Black water gathers between the roots of the `gswamp`x, filmed at the edges with green scum. Coarse growth hides patches of mud that bear the soft impressions of older disturbances. The air smells thickly of wet earth and rotting leaves, and every apparently firm patch ends in another uncertain margin.

dream.are:390671.name: An old growth forest (Forest)
dream.are:390671.description: A forked trunk marks the left-hand margin, with green moss caught in the sheltered angle below it. New growth threads through an older tangle, making a finer green texture among the heavier stems. The nearest textures are easy to follow, but the tangle beyond them resists a clear, uninterrupted view.

dream.are:390674.name: Hotel Antlers - Room 102
dream.are:390674.description: A narrow band of chalk-white wood follows the far wall behind the `wbed`x, giving the sleeping corner a quiet emphasis. A framed botanical print makes the room feel personal without explaining who chose it. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390675.name: Hotel Antlers - Room 103
dream.are:390675.description: The far corner holds a `wbed`x with rounded edges, the nearby trim picking up the tones of honey-colored wood. Two differently textured pillows soften the head of the mattress; the nearer one keeps a shallow crease. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

dream.are:390679.name: The Restrooms
dream.are:390679.description: A vertical strip of cream enamel divides the `wshower`x from the room's closer fittings on the far side. The mirror has a narrow beveled edge, splitting nearby shapes into a second, thinner reflection. The air carries a faint mineral coolness beneath the sharper smell of cleaning.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

dream.are:390680.name: The Toolshed
dream.are:390680.description: A deep storage recess breaks the right-hand wall, with dark iron covering the heavier lower fittings. The wall carries the faint outlines of older storage divisions, visible beneath the more recent finish. The practical fittings leave little decorative surplus, making the small signs of handling unusually visible.

dream.are:390687.name: an apartments complex
dream.are:390687.description: A broad section of dark walnut frames the `wsofa`x at the far end, giving the room a comfortable center. The upholstery changes texture where a smooth outer panel meets the heavier weave of the cushions. Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

dream.are:390688.name: Room of Mist
dream.are:390688.description: A broad panel of brushed steel gives the right-hand wall a quiet focus within the otherwise open hall. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The restrained details become noticeable during a pause, then fall back into the ordinary business of passing through.

dream.are:390692.name: A Victorian-era Room
dream.are:390692.description: The right-hand corner gathers a `wsofa`x and a low, oval table against a finish of honey-colored wood. A low table has softly rounded corners and a pale inlay that follows the outer edge. Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.

The immediate ground is clearest through the middle, where ordinary passage has kept the margins at bay.

places: sofa

hvntown.are:14336.name: a welcoming living room
hvntown.are:14336.description: The right-hand corner gathers a `wsofa`x and a low, oval table against a finish of smoke-blue paint. Small framed prints hang at different heights, making an informal balance out of their mismatched proportions. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

hvntown.are:10241.name: a Sidewalk flanking Badwater Quay
hvntown.are:10241.description: A narrow strip of green-veined rock marks the far boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. A small tuft of stubborn growth has found a pocket between two differently finished surfaces. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

hvntown.are:6145.name: a center channel
hvntown.are:6145.description: The right-hand channel wall thickens around a blunt structural pier, narrowing the visible water beside it. The confined surface returns broken reflections from the nearest stone, making the channel seem deeper than the visible bottom.

hvntown.are:10242.name: a sidewalk leading up to The Brawling Brothers Pub

hvntown.are:18437.name: the second floor hallway

hvntown.are:10246.name: The Northern Parking Lot of Badwater Fitness

hvntown.are:16390.name: the brawling arena of The Brawling Brothers Pub
hvntown.are:16390.description: The near fittings follow the lines of the playing surface, turning the room's proportions toward the activity. The nearest wall has a more forgiving finish below shoulder height than the plain surface above. The arrangement makes movement legible, with the strongest lines following the repeated paths of play. Old dents pit the pub's stout woodwork; the furnishings look accustomed to surviving an argument.

hvntown.are:14342.name: a tidy little bathroom
hvntown.are:14342.description: The `wshower`x occupies the left-hand corner, where a change in white ceramic makes the drain line easy to see. A pale towel folded over a simple rail adds the only soft texture among the washable surfaces. Reflections repeat between the polished surfaces, making the modest enclosure seem more intricate than it is. Careful upkeep shows in the clean edges and orderly surfaces.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

hvntown.are:18438.name: the front lobby
hvntown.are:18438.description: A low decorative panel of cream enamel frames the `wwaiting bench`x toward the far end of the reception space. A narrow directory panel is arranged in careful rows, with slightly different shades behind the oldest labels. The broad center makes movement legible, while the bench offers the more patient perspective of waiting.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

Old dents pit the pub's stout woodwork; the furnishings look accustomed to surviving an argument.

tables

Chairs gather around the long tabletop, their spacing keeping each face in view. Faint rings interrupt the finish. Leaning forward closes the distance across the table; sitting back leaves a more formal gap.

Repeated supports and worn concrete divide the mill into immense working bays, with rust collecting at joints and handling scars crossing the open ground. A low retaining curb turns around the heavier apparatus, separating the foundations from the traveled floor. The industrial surfaces have several kinds of wear, separating the places touched by hands from those shaped by heat and weight.

hvntown.are:15085.name: the stage

hvntown.are:4846.name: Underground Corridor

A small recess holds a deeper pocket of darkness within the otherwise readable wall. The building above is apparent as weight rather than a view, pressing the proportions down around the traveled floor.

hvntown.are:15086.name: a hallway
hvntown.are:15086.description: A rectangular recess interrupts the far side of the corridor, framed by a narrow border of blue-gray paint. The floor pattern shifts by a small fraction at an old join, making the repair easier to feel with the eye than to measure. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

hvntown.are:15087.name: the auditorium

The seats face the performance space in close rows. Fabric softens the small sounds of settling in, while worn armrests mark where earlier audiences have waited, watched, and leaned toward their companions.

hvntown.are:4848.name: Cell One
hvntown.are:4848.description: A shallow recess in the far wall contains the bench, framed by heavier chalky stone. The floor has a smoother wear along the shortest route between the boundaries. The hard enclosure keeps sound close, returning the smallest scrape with an unwelcome clarity.

hvntown.are:15088.name: the men's restroom

hvntown.are:8945.name: the celler

hvntown.are:15089.name: a hallway

The cool, mineral air holds no trace of domestic life. Here, even an ordinary shift of weight sounds like an interruption. A branching stain follows a hidden route through the rock before spreading into a wider patch. The stone changes texture across a crooked line, from fine grain to small, glittering inclusions.

hvntown.are:3186.name: Exhibitionist Room 2 - The Nymph's Rest
hvntown.are:3186.description: The right-hand floor widens around a low projection from the wall, making the open interior slightly asymmetrical. A simple wall plate sits a little above the surrounding trim, the corners softly rounded. The clear passage carries sound farther than the close walls first suggest. Dark trim and theatrical upholstery lend the Nymph's Rest the close, perfumed atmosphere of a confidence shared backstage.

hvntown.are:1138.name: the Arkwright Mausoleum
hvntown.are:1138.description: Heavy stone shuts the mausoleum around a small central space. Dust lies in the joints of the memorial surfaces, and age has softened the sharper edges of the masonry. Firm padding covers a narrow, easily cleaned table. The raised surface leaves room to stand close on either side, keeping patient and attendant within quiet speaking distance.

hvntown.are:9334.name: a tunnel trove of munitions

hvntown.are:9337.name: a sunken arena deep within the Underbelly

hvntown.are:5242.name: the observation deck

hvntown.are:9338.name: the gambler's tunnel
hvntown.are:9338.description: The left-hand masonry thickens around a squared support, exposing rougher dark basalt beneath the finished edge. hvntown.are:9339.name: a skeevy tunnel infested with vendors

Fine tool marks cross the stout working surface, with dust caught in the deepest cuts. The bench stands at a practical height for leaning over a piece of work, bringing careful hands and curious company together.

hvntown.are:9341.name: the fighters' cage

hvntown.are:9342.name: a Spartan Classroom

The `wrear desks`x form a close row behind the nearer seats, their tops carrying a fine web of idle scratches.

rear desks

hvntown.are:9568.name: the White Oak Biodome
hvntown.are:9568.description: Curving structural ribs divide the biodome enclosure above cultivated ground. Beds of vegetation occupy the space within the framework, their irregular leaves set against the deliberate geometry of the `wdomed shell`x. A low ridge of fine gravel divides the far growth into two differently textured drifts. A small marker leans among the stems, almost lost at the height of the lower leaves. The cultivated ground smells richly of earth, with a greener trace where leaves and stems meet at close quarters.

hvntown.are:1376.name: the entrance to the sheriff's office

places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

hvntown.are:9569.name: the women's restroom

places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

hvntown.are:3425.name: the first floor hallway

hvntown.are:5812.name: a walkway

A repaired section uses smaller stones fitted around the older work like a rough mosaic. The narrow margins make the enclosing structure feel close, every seam and mineral stain held within easy reach.

limbo.are:9.name: An Immortal Office
limbo.are:9.description: The `wdesk`x faces the left-hand half of the room beneath a restrained band of blue-gray paint. A document tray has been turned slightly away from the visitor, presenting the neat backs of stacked folders. Paper and dry furniture polish give the room the settled smell of work that mostly happens sitting down.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

limbo.are:10.name: a corridor
limbo.are:10.description: A band of cream enamel follows the right-hand wall, turning a plain passage into a sequence of long, horizontal lines. The floor pattern shifts by a small fraction at an old join, making the repair easier to feel with the eye than to measure. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

limbo.are:11.name: an old safehouse
limbo.are:11.description: A shallow recess faced in cream plaster shelters the `wsofa`x on the far side. A rug carries a repeating diamond pattern, interrupted near one edge by a deliberately contrasting border. Small sounds lose their sharpness among the soft furnishings, giving a conversation room to slow down.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

limbo.are:12.name: the Void
limbo.are:12.description: An unbounded `cvoid`x surrounds a single point of awareness. There is no wall or floor to measure it against, only the strange impression that the emptiness is close enough to touch. Small framed prints hang at different heights, making an informal balance out of their mismatched proportions. A little shelf holds an arrangement of ordinary ornaments chosen for color rather than symmetry.

limbo.are:13.name: a corridor
limbo.are:13.description: The ceiling drops slightly toward the right-hand wall, where cream enamel picks out the change in level. The upper finish has a finer texture than the more durable strip close to shoe height. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

limbo.are:14.name: Time-Out
limbo.are:14.description: Plain walls and an uncluttered floor enclose a small, quiet room. The empty center and restrained surfaces give the space an air of deliberate separation from the activity beyond it.

limbo.are:15.name: delete
limbo.are:15.description: A square patch of pearl-gray paint marks the right-hand wall where the surrounding finish changes depth. A hairline seam crosses the floor and disappears beneath the base of the wall. There is a faint mineral smell beneath the dry air, the scent of a room reduced to the materials that make it.

limbo.are:16.name: delete
limbo.are:16.description: A shallow recess interrupts the far wall, outlined by a narrow lip of warm terracotta. The ceiling has a shallow step that makes one corner seem unexpectedly close. The open floor makes the slightest unevenness conspicuous, a landscape of small seams and shallow shadows.

limbo.are:17.name: delete
limbo.are:17.description: A shallow recess interrupts the far wall, outlined by a narrow lip of chalk-white wood. A narrow shadow lies inside the deepest joint, emphasizing the spare geometry. There is a faint mineral smell beneath the dry air, the scent of a room reduced to the materials that make it.

limbo.are:21.name: Bank
limbo.are:21.description: The left-hand floor widens before a heavy dividing structure edged with gray tile. A shallow display recess holds a single decorative object, giving the surrounding blank surface a deliberate focus. The orderly surroundings keep the public position easy to read and the more protected spaces clearly separate.

limbo.are:40.name: Genesis Chamber
limbo.are:40.description: Distance gathers around a small point of orientation, then loosens before it becomes a recognizable place. The edges of the `cspace`x have the wavering certainty of a remembered room. It's difficult to hold any one detail in view for long; something about the surroundings always seems to have just changed. Public furnishings show the comfortable knocks of shared use, giving the union building a warmth that survives the durable institutional finish.

limbo.are:50.name: Movement and Helpfiles
limbo.are:50.description: Information about all the game's systems and lore is available in helpfiles. You can also find it all on our website, http://paroxysm.net To look at a helpfile type help (file name). If there is more than one match you can use help 2.(file name) etc. You can use helpsearch (argument) to look for any helpfile that contains that text. You can also type commands to see a list of commands, and then use help <commandname>. To move about the game you'll use the cardinal directions, north, south, east, west, northeast, southeast, northwest, southwest, up, down. Simply type one on a new line and hit enter; you can also use the shortcuts, n, s, e, w, ne, se, nw, sw, u, d. In each room you'll see the available exits, in this room the only available exit is to the north. Type n and hit enter when you are ready to proceed. Using the map command out of combat will list the game's maps, while if you have a phone phone gps will show your current location inside the town. In combat the map command shows you your immediate surroundings instead. If you are in a property you can use map level to see a layout of the nearby area. If you would rather not see descriptions automatically when you enter a room you can use the brief command.

limbo.are:51.name: Communication
limbo.are:51.description: If at any time you have a problem or issue you can ask for help OOCly from other players by typing newbie <message>, for example, newbie How do I set my title? This will send a message to everyone on the game. You can also write people notes OOCly, see help note for more information on how to do that. When in the game you can talk ICly with the say and whisper commands, you can also use say to <person>, or whisper person to direct them to someone in particular. The say command also accepts brackets to change the way in which you speak. So you could use say (while laughing) That's a good one. And it would appear as <Your name> says, while laughing, 'That's a good one.' The emote command allows you to convey in-game actions, for instance emote laughs hard would appear like <Your name> laughs hard. Some simple emotes are pre-written as socials, you can see a list of these by typing socials, and use them by just typing their name and any possible targets afterwards. The emote command can be used in a variety of ways, best explained in help emoting. To communicate with members of your faction, society or cult you can use the fsay, ssay, or csay commands respectively. Your character will also likely have a phone you can use to text or call people, see help phone.

limbo.are:52.name: Clothes and Tailoring
limbo.are:52.description: It's relatively important for your character to be dressed before you proceed on grid. In this room you can buy clothing and customize it to suit you better. Type list to see everything that's available, and then buy <number> to purchase something. Once it is purchased you can wear it by simply typing wear <object> or customize it with the customize command. For instance, buy 1, followed by wear shorts, would purchase and then wear a pair of white cotton shorts. You can look at help customize for a full list of options, but at a basic level simply use customize <object> to enter an editor to change the details of an item. The shortstring is what's used when the object is in messages, longstring is what's seen when it's worn or on the ground, and names are the words that can be used to target it. When giving an item a wear string you can enclose it in brackets () to make it show up in front of the item instead of behind. It's important not to use the customize command to make something more expensive than what is actually paid for it, in these cases you can use customize cost to increase the cost appropriately. Over time you'll assemble several outfits, which can be managed with the outfit command, help outfit. The wear command can take layers and locations as arguments, see help wear for more information. You can also use the expose and unexpose commands to manipulate worn clothes, help expose. (This room is a universal stash, see help stash.) A `wshower`x provides a place to wash before getting dressed.
places: shower
Washable surfaces enclose the shower, with a drain beneath the washing space.

limbo.are:53.name: Organizations
limbo.are:53.description: Much of what happens in Gravesend is a political struggle between different organizations. While you don't have to join one of these organizations it is generally harder to find things to do or purpose if you do not. Factions are groups that are worldwide, player leaders of these groups have an NPC boss. Societies are groups that are more local, they might also have chapters elsewhere but PC leaders do not really have a boss. Cults are secretive player made groups that worship a spirit known as an Eidolon, help Eidolon. Characters can be in up to one of each type of these groups. You use faction list to see a list of these groups, faction info (name) for more information on each of them or faction join to join one. See help society commands for all the commands. Another important organization in the city is Windermere University, this is a traditional university but also offers classes in the supernatural. Students can also be in factions/societies but will be considered interns and of lower rank. Being a student is often a good idea if you are a new player. You can view help college for more information. Additionally there are certain families which are particularly famous in the supernatural world, known as famed families you can see a list of them in help famed families. To join one of these families you just need to change your surname to match them, you can then use the commands in help family. While not a group PCs can join there are several other organizations that players can work for while on plots and the like, you can see help associations for a list of those.

limbo.are:54.name: Combat
limbo.are:54.description: There are three types of combat in Paroxysm. Fast combat is real time and what will happen if you type attack (target). Slow Combat is turn based and what will happen if you type spar (target). RP Combat is semi-turn based and more of a coded support system for narrative combat that is not very dependent on combat specific stats or abilities. You can start a rpfight with rpfight (target). The simplest move in combat is to simply type attack <target> this will pick the best discipline for the job and use a basic attack against that opponent with it. You can combine this with the move command that allows you to move towards someone with move <target> charge, or away from them with move <target> retreat and it will allow you to engage in simple easy fights. If you want to get involved in more complex fights however, you will want to set up and use custom attacks, with their own strings and special effects. Help custom attacks for more information about them, you also might want to view help move for more information on other types of battle movement. You can find NPC enemies to fight and earn yourself combat exp by heading towards the part of the city within the mist. You can use the weather command to see where the center of the mist is, but it's not a good idea to go straight to the center, head to a few blocks away and head slowly towards it until you start to see mist. You can use the speed command to alter your default combat speed when fighting NPCs, see help speed.

limbo.are:55.name: Roleplaying
limbo.are:55.description: Paroxysm is a roleplay enforced game, that means at all times while in the game your character should act like a real person, a fictional character with their own identity and actions, and not simply as a video game avatar. You can think of it like writing an interactive story. If you've never played a RP game before, look for someone to help steer you around the curves. Many people have different definitions of what makes good roleplay and good roleplayers, but it mostly boils down simply to not being too selfish, and giving some consideration to the enjoyment of others while writing a believable and interesting character. If you'd like to read a long guide on roleplaying, type help roleplaying guide.

limbo.are:56.name: Concept
limbo.are:56.description: This is your last chance to check over everything about your character to ensure you are ready to go, while most aspects of your character can still be changed once you enter the game a few cannot and others will have costs applied. Before entering the game please ensure your character is compliant with the setting and lore, see help lore if you want to go over any of those files again. In particular only characters with the fleshformed modifier can have any inhuman characteristics. This is the last room of the newbie school, once you venture forth your character will be real, be sure they're ready for that, good luck and I hope you enjoy our game. Type Enter to enter the game.

limbo.are:57.name: Training and Development
limbo.are:57.description: In order to customize and develop your character you can train various stats, powers and disciplines. Stats are bought with roleplay experience earned through roleplay of all types and can vary between -1 and 5. You can use the command stats to see what stats you have, and stats cost to see what ones you can buy. Each level of a stat costs more to raise than the last, level 1 costs 10,000 RP xp, level 2, 20,000, 3, 30,000 and so on. So the total cost to raise a stat from 0 to 5 is 150,000 RP Exp. You begin the game with 150,000 newbie RP exp to set up your character. To raise a stat just type train (stat name). You can do this anywhere. If you make a mistake you can use negtrain (stat name) to return the stat for a refund. But keep in mind that once you're out in the game world this refund won't be the full cost of the stat. (See help training methods for more information.) Powers are the same as stats, but represent things related to the supernatural world or abilities. Use the powers command or powers cost to see them and train them in the same way. Disciplines are a statistic that's used specifically in combat, they can be ranged, melee, or defensive. Disciplines are raised with experience earned by engaging in combat. They cost 200 experience times the level it's being raised to. So to raise a discipline from 0 to 1 costs 200, from 1 to 2 costs 400, from 2 to 3 costs 600 etc. You start the game with 150,000 newbie combat exp to use to set up your character. To raise your disciplines just use train (discipline name) if you make a mistake, negtrain works for them the same as it does for other stats. You can use the disciplines command to see your current disciplines, and use disciplines cost to see the cost of raising any of them.

limbo.are:58.name: Descriptions
limbo.are:58.description: Characters should have a description. The simplest way to describe your character is to simply type describe self. This will put you into an editor where you can write a few lines about what your character looks like. If you are feeling more adventurous however, Paroxysm has a much more detailed description system you can make use of. To do this type describe (location) to start writing a description of each part of your body. Whatever parts of your body are exposed then will be shown when people look at you, just remember to add a space or a newline at the end or beginning of different parts that are displayed next to each other. You can customize the order in which these parts appear with describe order (location) (number), with lower numbers appearing first. You can use ddesc create (keyword) (location) to create dynamic descriptions for different body parts that you can switch on and off to update your description. You can also use detail (location) (over/under) to describe parts of your character's body in greater depth. This won't be seen by anybody looking at the character normally, but will be if they decide to look at that part of you in greater detail with look (person) (location). Over details are always displayed, while under details are displayed only when that part of your body is exposed. You use look (person) to see their description and clothing. You can use glance instead to just see the parts of their appearance that have changed since you last looked at them. You can use glance (person) to see more basic information about them. You can use qlook (person) for a quick overview of what they look like. There is no need to describe every body part of your character, you should aim for short, readable descriptions wherever possible.

limbo.are:59.name: Setting
limbo.are:59.description: Paroxysm is a modern, paranormal horror game set in the city of Gravesend, a city that exists in the liminal space between worlds with an unclear origin. Paroxysm is a horror setting in which the foundational principle is that power equals corruption. It is not just a saying that power corrupts in this world, it is an unbreakable metaphysical law. All the most powerful individuals are corrupt and so are most of the more powerful organizations. The two primary themes of the game are Heroic Horror and Gothic Horror. Heroic Horror is a term that refers to horror settings in which heroism is still possible and, at least somewhat, effective. Unlike in some horror genres where characters can only hope to survive their antagonists, in heroic horror it is possible to defeat them and improve the state of the world. It differs from standard heroic fantasy in that the victories characters achieve are small scale and the overall state of the world is never meaningfully moved to a just or orderly standard. In heroic fantasy characters generally protect a basically just and moral world from being corrupted, in heroic horror they are just trying to stop an immoral and corrupt world from getting worse. The aesthetic of heroes in heroic horror is much closer to resistance fighters than soldiers or police. Gothic Horror is a term that refers to a genre of horror in which supernatural elements function as metaphors for real world psychological or social conflicts. It also has a heavy emphasis on conveying a general feeling of unease or haunting. In Paroxysm all the Demons, Gods, Fae etc used to be human, and many supernatural elements function as exaggerations of real human traits or what-ifs that can function as the basis for psychological exploration. It's important to keep these themes in mind while playing, as all the mechanics and lore are written with this in mind. Let them guide the conflicts, choices, and consequences you explore through your character.

limbo.are:60.name: SR Hangout
limbo.are:60.description: A plain gathering room provides a quiet pause for storytellers. A `wshared table`x stands among simple chairs, with clear floor around the seated group.

limbo.are:61.name: Rules
limbo.are:61.description: Paroxysm is an IC enforced game. That means once you leave newbie school and enter out into the game world you will be behaving as your character at all times. Most of the rules are simply about ensuring everyone is playing ICly and preventing common internet abuse. See help rules for a full list. You should also familiarize yourself with our policies, please use help policies. If you need to contact the staff of the game for any reason, you should use a petition, see help petition.

limbo.are:62.name: Concept and Character
limbo.are:62.description: The most fundamental part of your character is their archetype, there are various supernatural and mundane character types, you can see them all in help archetype. Higher tier archetypes are more powerful but also inevitably more evil as in this setting power always equals corruption. You can alter the tier of a character by taking a positive or negative modifier. Note that you generally cannot change your archetype once you leave newbie school, but you can change your modifiers. You should look at help moral tier to understand how to play your character's level of corruption. Your character also came from somewhere, type history to enter an editor and write your character's history. While you don't have to do this now, it eventually will become compulsory to have a history if you keep playing. Characters also require some secrets, you can use the secrets command to write a description of yours. These are generally invisible to most other players unless they have a specific legendary power. You should also consider your character's drives, in Paroxysm drives are either fears or ambitions. When your drives negatively impact your character you have a chance to gain a bonus, see help cdrives for more information. Your character also likely has habits, use the habit command to set these to represent the sorts of things your character does while 'offscreen'. When in the game you also may wish to form coded relationships with others see help relationships. All of these fields can be seen by typing lookup self, and your basic information can be seen with score.

limbo.are:69.name: The Abyss
limbo.are:69.description: The left-hand surroundings fall away beyond a broad shape of cream mineral deposits, leaving the air itself unenclosed. A change in angle would rearrange the overlapping shapes more quickly than an eye expects. There is no floor here, only the exposed scale of open air and the distant arrangement beneath it.

limbo.are:96.name: a birthing sac
limbo.are:96.description: Curved, yielding surfaces enclose a close organic hollow. Fine folds give the inner boundary a layered texture, surrounding the center with an unsettling sense of containment.

limbo.are:97.name: Floating in nothingness
limbo.are:97.description: The left-hand view gathers the nearer ground into overlapping bands, one pale strip of pale limestone standing out among them. The surrounding emptiness gives every visible edge an unusual emphasis. Height strips familiar things of their ordinary size, leaving the sky immense around a few small points of reference.

limbo.are:98.description: Weather-softened memorial stone rises from the uneven ground, with darker earth settled into the carved lines. The right-hand margin rises gently against a low retaining edge of pale limestone. An older stain has faded to a soft outline, most distinct where the surrounding ground changes texture. This is ground meant to be crossed or briefly paused upon, shaped by ordinary use rather than furnishings.

limbo.are:99.name: Prison
limbo.are:99.description: The bench occupies the near edge, where the enclosing surfaces meet at a blunt, close angle. The nearest joint is packed flat, denying the rough surface even a useful-looking recess. The bench offers a place to sit without making the confinement comfortable.

limbo.are:100.name: entrance to the grid room defaults
limbo.are:100.description: The `wwaiting bench`x sits beneath a shallow wall recess on the right-hand side, where the finish changes to white ceramic. The floor pattern shifts by half a tile near the edge, a small irregularity in an otherwise formal arrangement. The space balances welcome with a little institutional distance, keeping arrivals plainly in view.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

The cultivated ground smells richly of earth, with a greener trace where leaves and stems meet at close quarters.

The worked soil changes color around the nearest roots, revealing the different places moisture settles. The plants provide the focus here, leaving the ordinary gaps between them as part of the setting.

limbo.are:135.name: a coastal biome
limbo.are:135.description: Coarse sand and low coastal growth divide the cultivated environment into patches. Shell fragments and hardy leaves give the biome the texture of an exposed shore.

limbo.are:136.name: a tropical biome
limbo.are:136.description: Broad leaves overlap above dark planted soil. Tangled stems and rich layers of growth give the cultivated biome a dense, close-grained texture.

limbo.are:137.name: the redwood walkways
limbo.are:137.description: Timber surfaces lie among immense redwood trunks. Repeated board joints contrast with the deep, irregular grain of the surrounding bark.

limbo.are:138.name: a consultation office
limbo.are:138.description: The `wdesk`x faces the right-hand half of the room beneath a restrained band of pale green paint. A line of shallow drawers breaks the lower fittings into compact, carefully measured compartments. The cleared working edge gives every meeting the same quiet starting point.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

limbo.are:139.name: the training courtyard
limbo.are:139.description: The left-hand margin rises gently against a low retaining edge of blue-gray shale. The immediate ground is clearest through the middle, where ordinary passage has kept the margins at bay. Nothing closes the space overhead; the surrounding forms frame the ground without turning it into an interior.

limbo.are:140.name: the training courtyard
limbo.are:140.description: A narrow strip of cream mineral deposits marks the right-hand boundary between the traveled ground and the rougher margin. A small tuft of stubborn growth has found a pocket between two differently finished surfaces. Nothing closes the space overhead; the surrounding forms frame the ground without turning it into an interior.

limbo.are:141.name: a lounge
limbo.are:141.description: The near half is arranged around a `wsofa`x, with muted green paint outlining the quieter edges of the room. A shallow decorative bowl catches the room in a curved, imperfect reflection. Fabric and furniture polish mingle faintly in the enclosed air, a comfortable smell without much ceremony.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

limbo.are:142.name: a path leading to the grove
limbo.are:142.description: The left-hand planting curves around a shallow bed of weathered bark, breaking the cultivated ground into a softer outline. One low plant carries a pale border around each leaf, making a delicate pattern close to the ground. The cultivated ground smells richly of earth, with a greener trace where leaves and stems meet at close quarters.

limbo.are:143.name: the bottom of a handsome wooden stair
limbo.are:143.description: A broad section of cream enamel frames the right-hand edge of the stairs beneath a sharply angled ceiling. A broader tread interrupts the climb, the corners polished smoother than the wide, shallow center. The enclosure gives each small sound a short, climbing echo.

limbo.are:144.name: a locker room
limbo.are:144.description: The left-hand storage compartments face a simple `wbench`x across a modest patch of clear floor. The nearest floor has a fine grip texture, interrupted by a smoother strip beneath the bench. A faint fabric smell lingers in the close air, and the clear floor leaves room for the awkward movements of changing.
places: bench

The bench offers a firm seat, the most-used stretch worn smoother than the ends. Small nicks catch along the edge. It's a straightforward place to sit shoulder to shoulder without crowding the open floor.

limbo.are:145.name: a deployment and ready room
limbo.are:145.description: A shallow recess interrupts the far wall, outlined by a narrow lip of honey-colored wood. The ceiling has a shallow step that makes one corner seem unexpectedly close. The open floor makes the slightest unevenness conspicuous, a landscape of small seams and shallow shadows.

limbo.are:146.name: an open air clinic
limbo.are:146.description: The right-hand view opens above a narrow line of green-veined rock, reducing the ground to texture and proportion. The nearer surfaces show their upper faces, revealing outlines usually lost when viewed from the ground. There is no floor here, only the exposed scale of open air and the distant arrangement beneath it.

limbo.are:147.name: a cosy library alcove
limbo.are:147.description: Bookcases frame the `wreading table`x along the near wall, with dark walnut outlining their deeper recesses. Shelf labels use small, careful lettering, their edges softened where readers have brushed past. There is a patient, scholarly quiet here, made by materials that change more slowly than the people handling them.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

limbo.are:148.name: the staff cots
limbo.are:148.description: Simple cots occupy a compact resting space. The nearest `wbed`x has creased `wbed`xding and a firm edge for sitting, bringing quiet company close among the neighboring cots.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

limbo.are:149.name: the shower room
limbo.are:149.description: A vertical strip of dark wood divides the `wshower`x from the room's closer fittings on the near side. The mirror has a narrow beveled edge, splitting nearby shapes into a second, thinner reflection. The close fittings leave the room practical and intimate, scaled to the small business of washing.
places: shower
Pale mineral trails mark the shower fittings above the drained washing space. Water patters against the floor beneath the spray, and the close air carries a clean trace of soap.

limbo.are:150.name: a picnic area and fire pit
limbo.are:150.description: The left-hand rock narrows into a buttress whose rough grain contrasts with the smoother chalky stone beside it. The floor holds a fan of broken chips, grading from blunt fragments to fine grit. The natural shapes remain stubbornly indifferent to a human-sized sense of comfort or symmetry.

limbo.are:151.name: a cluttered utility shed

A narrow strip of floor has a rougher texture, giving the working surface a clear change underfoot. The practical fittings leave little decorative surplus, making the small signs of handling unusually visible.

limbo.are:152.name: the top of a handsome wooden stair

limbo.are:155.name: a holding cell

limbo.are:156.name: a walkway

limbo.are:157.name: a walkway

limbo.are:158.description: The near treatment position is organized around a narrow `wtreatment table`x and a broad panel of white ceramic. Antiseptic leaves a sharp edge in the air, and the clear surfaces make the enclosure feel deliberately exposed.

The undecorated surfaces leave the proportions unusually easy to read, from the low corners to the open middle.

mexico.are:34057.description: Two broad planes meet at an awkward angle on the near side, with muted green paint picked out along the join. Fine tool strokes remain visible beneath the last layer of wall finish. The open floor makes the slightest unevenness conspicuous, a landscape of small seams and shallow shadows.

mexico.are:34058.description: A shallow recess interrupts the far wall, outlined by a narrow lip of smoke-blue paint. The ceiling has a shallow step that makes one corner seem unexpectedly close. The quiet has an unfinished quality, as though the next ordinary use might finally give the space a character.

mexico.are:34059.description: A square patch of dark walnut marks the right-hand wall where the surrounding finish changes depth. The ceiling has a shallow step that makes one corner seem unexpectedly close. Without furniture to soften the enclosure, every small sound acquires a dry little echo.
