mists.are:41003.name: A Cozy Painting Studio
mists.are:41003.description: Painted studies climb the studio wall in an untidy ladder of color. A broad `wworktable`x stands beneath them, the nearest edge crusted with little ridges left by a palette knife. A jar-shaped stain has dried into a blue halo on the wood. The room smells of paper and worked paint, a close, companionable space made larger by the pictures filling it.
places: worktable

A broad working surface bears fine cuts, stains, and older repairs. The edge is rubbed smooth where people lean over a project, with enough room for companions to examine the same detail from either side.

mists.are:41007.name: A Frozen Tavern in Northgard
mists.are:41007.description: Frost has silvered the grain of the Northgard tavern's `wbar`x. Thick legs hold the `wtables`x above a floor darkened by older thaw marks, and the wall carvings wear white edges where cold has found the deepest cuts. The room has a stubborn, sheltering weight: heavy timber, broad furniture, and a bitter chill that makes the promise of company feel unusually precious.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

mists.are:41009.name: a deep, labyrinthian low-light tunnel system of iridescent reds
mists.are:41009.description: Iridescent red mineral skins coat the tunnel in overlapping scales. The nearest walls are close enough for the colors to break into wine-dark folds and thin coppery edges; farther away, the same surfaces merge into a bruised glow. Low ridges interrupt the gritty floor. The passage feels grown around a wound, intricate at arm's length and difficult to hold together as a whole.

mists.are:41010.name: Club Catacombs
mists.are:41010.description: Club Catacombs fits theatrical upholstery beneath the uncompromising weight of old masonry. A low `wsofa`x occupies an arched recess, the fabric richly textured beside stone that has never acquired a comfortable edge. The open floor carries a web of heel marks. Perfume lingers close to the cushions, unable to disguise the cellar's cool mineral smell.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41012.name: A Royal Bedchamber, Bathed in Candlelight
mists.are:41012.description: The royal `wbed`x rises on carved feet beneath a canopy lined in dull gold. Candle cups stand in carefully balanced groups around the chamber, their accumulated wax giving the formal arrangement a softer, less obedient outline. A faded hunting scene crosses the fabric behind the pillows. The room offers grandeur at a human distance, with the private creases of bedding beneath the ceremonial display.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41015.name: the vice and revelry of La Tasse Cassee
mists.are:41015.description: La Tasse Cassee has made an art of the cup that almost matches. Mismatched china gathers above the service fittings, while a `wcorner table`x sits beneath a print whose frame is more elaborate than the picture. Old coffee rings survive beside wine-colored stains in the tabletop. It's an intimate, disreputable sort of warmth, inviting a story to become more interesting with each leisurely retelling.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

mists.are:41016.name: A Windowless, Doorless Chamber
mists.are:41016.description: No opening interrupts the chamber's walls. Pale, seamless surfaces curve into one another, denying the eye even the comfort of a definite corner. A small, darker oval marks the otherwise blank floor, looking less like a stain than a place the surrounding color has withdrawn from. The enclosure has no obvious center, yet every attempt to look away from the oval seems to return there.

mists.are:41025.name: A Cozy Painting Studio
mists.are:41025.description: A row of unfinished portraits faces the painting studio's `wworktable`x. Their backgrounds are complete, but several faces remain pale shapes inside carefully rendered collars. Thin strips of color test the edges of the nearest working board. The room smells of dry paper and old varnish, with the uneasy intimacy of a gathering whose guests have not quite become people.
places: worktable

A broad working surface bears fine cuts, stains, and older repairs. The edge is rubbed smooth where people lean over a project, with enough room for companions to examine the same detail from either side.

mists.are:41029.name: an Abandoned Well
mists.are:41029.description: The abandoned well drops within a collar of rough masonry. The `wstone rim`x has been smoothed by hands and weather, but the inner blocks keep sharp, uneven edges beneath a dark mineral skin. A broken length of old fitting rests against the outer wall. The cool air rising from below carries the smell of wet stone and a depth the visible opening cannot adequately explain.
places: stone rim
The upper stone is broad and smoothed by weather and handling, cool against a resting palm. Shallow pits interrupt the worn edge, with room to lean together beside the masonry and look over the rim.

mists.are:41032.name: chunk light tuna
mists.are:41032.description: Curved, silver-colored walls enclose a space with the unlikely proportions of an opened tin. Close parallel ridges run around the enclosure, while pale, fibrous layers form the ground beneath them. The upper edge has the sharp, unfinished outline of peeled metal. It's an absurdly domestic dream enlarged to walking size, carrying a faint briny smell and no convincing place for ordinary furniture.

mists.are:41034.name: the Hidden Tunnels Below the Rue de Belleville
mists.are:41034.description: The hidden tunnels beneath the Rue de Belleville have been patched with masonry from several different jobs. Pale brick interrupts older stone, and one broad repair has swallowed the lower half of a faded wall mark. A shallow drainage line follows the floor before bending out of the immediate view. The city feels present above as pressure and distance, reduced here to damp joints and enclosed air.

mists.are:41035.name: The Pit
mists.are:41035.description: The pit narrows between walls that show different layers of disturbed ground. Coarse rubble forms a broken skirt below firmer material, with pale fragments trapped in darker earth. One projecting stone has been rubbed smooth along the upper face, although the surrounding edges remain sharp. The confined depth makes the skyward opening feel less like an exit than a measure of how much lies overhead.

mists.are:41036.name: Bestia of Los Angeles
mists.are:41036.description: Industrial edges and carefully chosen dining details meet at Bestia. A `wcorner table`x rests against rougher material than the smoothly finished tabletop, with the contrast repeated in dark fittings and softer cloth. A restrained framed image interrupts the longest stretch of wall. The room has a deliberate, urban warmth, giving an unhurried meal somewhere to settle inside the harder shell of the building.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

mists.are:41037.name: Small apartment
mists.are:41037.description: The apartment's `wsofa`x has been angled to make a small room feel less square. A low shelf follows the wall behind it, interrupted by a framed print and a single pale ceramic shape. The rug is slightly too narrow for the furniture, exposing a strip of floor along one side. Nothing quite matches, but the differences have the easy familiarity of choices made to live with.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41039.name: Bibliotheque of Alexandria
mists.are:41039.description: The Bibliotheque of Alexandria stacks the written world into close, uneven ranks. Tall shelves press around a broad `wreading table`x, their bindings running from brittle-looking cloth to dark leather worn smooth at the spine. Small labels have been fitted wherever space allowed, rather than in a single tidy line. The dry paper smell is deep enough to make the room seem older than the masonry enclosing it.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

mists.are:41040.name: The Stirling Bridge
mists.are:41040.description: The bridge presents a hard, weathered crossing above the surrounding reach. Stone at the exposed edge has rounded more heavily than the inner paving, leaving shallow hollows where finer grit collects. The near parapet has a single darker block among the pale work. The span offers the stark practicality of a crossing, with open air keeping the structure from ever feeling like a room.

mists.are:41041.name: The stately mansion of Pale Acres
mists.are:41041.description: A shallow recess faced in dark walnut shelters the `wsofa`x on the far side. A low table has softly rounded corners and a pale inlay that follows the outer edge. There is an easy domestic scale here: nothing grander than a shared table edge and a place to settle.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41042.name: an example plot room
mists.are:41042.description: The far ceiling steps down above a squared structural pier faced in sand-colored plaster. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The long proportions draw the eye past each small interruption in the wall, making the far end feel slightly removed.

mists.are:41045.name: Mama's Pancakes Diner
mists.are:41045.description: Mama's Pancakes Diner gathers sturdy chairs around tables with softly rounded edges. A `wcorner table`x sits beneath a cheerful print of a breakfast scene, the colors a little sweeter than anything in the practical furniture. A pale ring marks the tabletop where a warm dish once sat. The room holds a faint trace of coffee and syrup, the comfortable afterlife of an ordinary meal.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

mists.are:41046.name: Mama's Pancakes Diner
mists.are:41046.description: A strip of checked trim gives this version of Mama's Pancakes Diner a homemade cheerfulness. The `wcorner table`x rests beside a shallow display shelf, where mismatched crockery has been arranged with more affection than symmetry. The chair nearest the wall has a smoother back than the others. The room feels ready for company that knows the furniture well enough to have a favorite seat.
places: corner table
The corner table sits beyond the busiest line through the room. Chairs tuck close around a surface marked by faint rings and tiny scratches, making a comfortable pocket for an unhurried conversation.

mists.are:41048.name: A Cozy Painting Studio
mists.are:41048.description: Broad color studies lean against the painting studio's lower walls, leaving the upper surfaces almost bare. The `wworktable`x carries a fan of fine scratches around a darker, oval working patch. A narrow cloth hangs from one edge, stiff with several generations of dried pigment. The studio has the practical warmth of a place where making something matters more than keeping the surroundings presentable.
places: worktable

A broad working surface bears fine cuts, stains, and older repairs. The edge is rubbed smooth where people lean over a project, with enough room for companions to examine the same detail from either side.

mists.are:41049.name: The Crucible Club in Salem, Massachusetts
mists.are:41049.description: The Crucible Club frames an open floor with dark, heat-colored finishes. Curving decorative lines suggest rising flame without quite forming a picture. A `wsofa`x is tucked beneath the lowest part of the surrounding trim, the upholstery catching a faint trace of perfume. The contrast between the broad floor and the close seating gives the Salem club a theatrical sense of something waiting to begin.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41052.name: Small apartment
mists.are:41052.description: A compact `wsofa`x stands below a long, narrow picture in the small apartment. The frame is centered over the wall rather than the furniture, lending the whole arrangement a slight but persistent imbalance. A woven throw adds a warmer patch at one end. The room has the close, ordinary scale of a private refuge, with just enough space for company to become comfortable together.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41062.name: Boston Athenaeum
mists.are:41062.description: Substantial shelving lends the Boston Athenaeum a quiet gravity. A `wreading table`x occupies the clear space between book-lined edges, the nearest surface inlaid with a fine, darker border. Small differences in the shelf fittings reveal several periods of careful addition. The room smells of dry bindings and restrained polish, offering the patient comfort of being surrounded by more reading than a visit could exhaust.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

mists.are:41070.name: the entrance
mists.are:41070.description: The entrance narrows around a broad, slightly uneven threshold. The surrounding finish changes just inside it, from a rougher outer surface to material worn smooth along the line of passing hands. A shallow recess catches a darker pocket beside the clearer middle. The place holds the small hesitation of an arrival, neither spacious enough to settle in nor quite part of what lies beyond.

mists.are:41071.name: a Museum Warehouse in Baghdad
mists.are:41071.description: The Baghdad museum warehouse arranges oversized storage bays around a clear working floor. A wooden packing support has been built to an unusual curve, suggesting the shape of something no longer resting in it. Small inventory labels repeat on the nearest compartments. Dry dust and old timber give the enclosure a patient smell, while the fitted supports preserve absences almost as carefully as objects.

mists.are:41075.name: the Shimmering Heat-Dream of Suburban Domestic Nevada
mists.are:41075.description: The Nevada house has the perfect proportions of a remembered advertisement. A pale `wsofa`x faces a low table, and the edges of every domestic fitting soften slightly before they can be examined too closely. The walls seem sun-warmed without offering a reliable source for the warmth. It's a polished little dream of suburban ease, with something wavering just beyond the tidiest line.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41076.name: The Edge of Northgard, Nearing Niflheimr
mists.are:41076.description: The ground near Niflheimr has a hard, pale crust broken by darker seams. The nearest forms remain sharply outlined, but the farther landscape dissolves into layers that seem to belong to different distances. Frost-like patterns feather across the exposed material. The boundary of Northgard feels less like a line to cross than a gradual failure of familiar shapes to remain familiar.

mists.are:41079.name: picnic basket nice wicker
mists.are:41079.description: Thick bands of wicker curve around the space in an immense, interlocking weave. Narrow gaps expose an uncertain brightness beyond, while the floor is covered in fabric whose checks have become broad squares. A loop of bound material rises along one side like the root of a handle. The enclosure has the warm, dry smell of a picnic basket remembered from somewhere much smaller.

mists.are:41086.name: nowhere
mists.are:41086.description: The surroundings almost agree to become a place. A level surface gathers beneath the immediate view, then loosens toward edges that refuse to meet anything definite. A pale vertical shape might be a wall until attention rests on it. There's no convincing direction in which the uncertainty increases; nowhere seems equally near on every side.

mists.are:41093.name: old yellowed wooden Ouija board
mists.are:41093.description: Yellowed varnish covers boards broad enough to make a floor. Enormous letters arc across the grain, their dark edges softened by a network of fine cracks. A raised, pointer-shaped silhouette occupies the farther part of the dream, too still to suggest any answer. The space smells faintly of old wood, with the unsettling familiarity of a household object that has become a landscape.

mists.are:41094.name: An Abandoned Silver Mine in the Mountains of Thrace
mists.are:41094.description: The silver mine cuts a narrow working space through the mountain. Old supports have darkened where they meet the rock, and mineral threads pick out pale lines beyond the reach of ordinary handling. A low heap of chips has settled beneath a blunt tool scar. The air carries a cold, metallic dryness, with the abandoned workings retaining the shape of effort long after the workers have gone.

mists.are:41095.name: The Mall in Boston - Again
mists.are:41095.description: The mall looks familiar in a way that becomes less reassuring the longer it is examined. A `wcounter`x faces a broad retail floor, surrounded by display shapes that almost recall another visit. One decorative panel repeats where a different color seems expected. The polished public surfaces have the impersonal warmth of a place built to welcome everyone without remembering any of them.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

mists.are:41097.name: Test room
mists.are:41097.description: A long strip of blue-gray paint follows the near side at shoulder height, breaking the plain wall into two proportions. The floor pattern shifts by a small fraction at an old join, making the repair easier to feel with the eye than to measure. The restrained details become noticeable during a pause, then fall back into the ordinary business of passing through.

mists.are:41101.name: The Lush Oracle of Thrace, Shrouded In a Ravine in Bulgaria
mists.are:41101.description: The ravine shelters a dense fold of green around the Oracle of Thrace. Broad leaves overlap with finer sprays, and the nearest rock carries pale mineral trails beneath the growth. A small clear patch has been kept among the roots without being furnished or fenced. The place feels secluded through the weight of the surrounding landscape, with the cultivated details nearly swallowed by the natural enclosure.

mists.are:41103.name: An expansive library archive of the Watchers
mists.are:41103.description: The Watchers' archive presses high shelves around a broad `wreading table`x. Narrow classification slips project from the nearest bindings at carefully varied heights, creating a second pattern beyond the books themselves. A long ruled panel offers more order than explanation. The room smells dry and papery, with the peculiar weight of a collection assembled to notice what ordinary histories might overlook.
places: reading table

Broad enough for open books, the table keeps a clear working surface among the shelves. Fine scratches and a dull polish mark the places where readers have leaned, with chairs close enough to compare a passage in low voices.

mists.are:41104.name: La Femme en Rouge bordello in Port-au-Prince
mists.are:41104.description: La Femme en Rouge gathers deep red fabric into folds around a low `wsofa`x. The decorative trim is elaborate at a glance, then slightly uneven where the separate pieces meet. A small mirror returns a flattering fragment of the room rather than the whole arrangement. Perfume has settled into the upholstery, lending the Port-au-Prince bordello a warm, theatrical intimacy.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41108.name: Outside a discreet, stone building in Edinburgh, Scotland
mists.are:41108.description: The discreet Edinburgh building presents a close face of weathered stone. The approach is plain, with the ground worn most smoothly just before the threshold and darker grit gathered against the wall. A shallow carving above the nearest joint is too restrained to command attention. The exterior keeps the purpose of the rooms inside to itself, offering little more than solid masonry and an unshowy entrance.

mists.are:41109.name: the small, charming town of Charming, West Virginia
mists.are:41109.description: The small town gathers in modest built shapes around a patch of traveled ground. Repairs overlap along the nearest surfaces, their different shades lending Charming an unpolished, lived-in texture. A narrow decorative border has been carefully maintained beside more practical wear. The setting has the intimate scale of somewhere whose ordinary corners might become familiar before a visitor learns many names.

mists.are:41110.name: a Loud, Poorly Lit Strip Club
mists.are:41110.description: The strip club frames a broad performance floor with dark decorative panels and a low `wsofa`x. The upholstery holds perfume more readily than the harder room holds any sense of privacy. Fine heel marks cross the open surface in overlapping arcs. Even between performances, the arrangement is insistently theatrical, making the distinction between watching and being watched difficult to forget.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41112.name: The Institute
mists.are:41112.description: The Institute's interior is severe in small, consistent ways. Panel edges meet at precise heights, and the floor pattern continues beneath the fittings without a casual interruption. A narrow notice surface has been cleared almost completely, leaving one pale rectangle where paper recently rested. The room offers institutional order without much welcome, making a small misplaced object seem capable of becoming an event.

mists.are:41114.name: Deep in the ruins of Babylon
mists.are:41114.description: Broken masonry gathers into low, incomplete forms in the ruins of Babylon. A shallow band of decoration survives on one protected face, the pattern abruptly interrupted where the next section has fallen away. Fine dust fills the smaller cuts. The place is more legible in fragments than as a whole, with the remaining surfaces suggesting arrangements too large for the immediate view to restore.

mists.are:41115.name: Bed, Bath, and Beyond in Canton, Massachusetts
mists.are:41115.description: Retail shelving divides Bed, Bath, and Beyond into carefully presented domestic possibilities. Folded fabric makes neat blocks of color beside displays of household fittings, with a `wcounter`x marking the customer edge. One demonstration setting looks almost inhabited until the spacing gives away the display. The store has the dry, packaged smell of things waiting to become part of somebody's ordinary life.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

mists.are:41119.name: vegan lemon blueberry scone
mists.are:41119.description: A curved, crumb-textured surface rises around the space, pale gold beneath scattered dark-blue hollows. Fine cracks branch through the nearer material, while a yellowish edge suggests zest at a scale that makes little sense. The air carries a remembered sweetness rather than a convincing bakery smell. It's the interior logic of a scone made briefly large enough to wander through.

mists.are:41122.name: In a Candlelit Royal Bedchamber
mists.are:41122.description: Carved posts surround the royal `wbed`x, their upper leaves picked out against a canopy of heavy cloth. Candle fittings line the nearer wall, each one holding a different accumulation of cooled wax. A narrow embroidered border repeats along the bedding, more restrained than the room around it. The chamber feels ceremonious at first glance and unexpectedly personal at the scale of a pillow or a folded sheet.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41123.name: The Rusty Blade Bar (Beggar's End)
mists.are:41123.description: The `wbar`x follows the right-hand wall beneath substantial trim of honey-colored wood, with `wtables`x set farther back. The table legs have broad feet, giving the furniture a stubbornly stable appearance. The room offers a choice between the shared counter and the smaller company gathered around a table.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

mists.are:41125.name: a tidy little flat in London
mists.are:41125.description: The London flat makes careful use of a modest floor. A compact `wsofa`x faces a shallow book shelf, with a narrow rug leaving the outer edges of the room plainly visible. A small framed print is hung low enough to meet a seated glance. The furnishings have the quiet confidence of things chosen to fit, giving the tidy enclosure a comfortable life beyond mere neatness.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41127.name: a Museum Warehouse in Baghdad
mists.are:41127.description: A broad partition divides this Baghdad museum warehouse into unequal storage bays. The nearest racks hold fitted supports rather than a uniform run of shelves, each one shaped around a different sort of object. Paper labels sit beneath the heavier joints. A chalky dust has found the sheltered corners, giving the room the stillness of a collection resting between more public appearances.

mists.are:41129.name: a VIP Smoking Lounge within the Wynn Casino
mists.are:41129.description: The Wynn smoking lounge puts a generous `wsofa`x beneath a restrained sweep of polished trim. The fabric is dark enough to make the small reflective details seem brighter, while a low table holds the center of the seating arrangement. An old tobacco trace lingers beneath the cleaner furniture finish. The room offers an expensive sort of ease, with every comfortable distance looking carefully considered.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41130.name: a Museum Warehouse in Baghdad
mists.are:41130.description: The museum warehouse in Baghdad opens around a low, reinforced handling platform. An unusually tall storage frame dominates one side, the empty spaces between the supports as conspicuous as the timber itself. Small patches of protective padding remain fixed at different heights. The enclosure feels practical and watchful, built to hold things whose most awkward shapes have already been anticipated.

mists.are:41131.name: On the Set of Revenge: Best Served Cold!
mists.are:41131.description: The set of Revenge: Best Served Cold! is convincing until the eye follows a wall too far. A finished surface ends beside the rough back of a scenic panel, and an apparently solid fitting reveals a lighter supporting frame from the side. The floor carries quiet marks for positions and alignment. The place holds two realities at once: the room being presented and the workshop making the presentation possible.

mists.are:41132.name: a dream-like Divine Sanctum
mists.are:41132.description: Pale curves gather around the divine sanctum without settling into ordinary architecture. Each border seems complete until the next one suggests a larger pattern continuing beyond it. A small central motif repeats in finer forms along the enclosing surfaces. The space has a beautiful, difficult composure, as though every detail belongs exactly where it is while the whole remains beyond a comfortable explanation.

mists.are:41133.name: an Off-The-Books Casino in an Abandoned Warehouse
mists.are:41133.description: Gaming furniture occupies an abandoned warehouse shell with an air of deliberate understatement. A `wcard table`x sits beneath exposed structural work, the softer playing surface sharply different from the scarred industrial floor. The surrounding fittings are practical rather than grand. The room feels arranged for people who prefer the business in front of them to draw less attention than the building around it.
places: card table
A felt-covered top softens the little sounds of cards and chips. The padded rim offers a comfortable rest for an elbow, and the close seating keeps every small change of expression within view.

mists.are:41135.name: a Swanky Office in an Abandoned Warehouse's Basement
mists.are:41135.description: A broad `wdesk`x gives the basement office a polish the abandoned warehouse above has not earned. Refined trim meets a heavier lower wall, and a carefully chosen chair faces the working surface across a measured gap. A framed print conceals part of an older repair. The room's swanky presentation feels intentional down to the last edge, a private claim staked inside the rougher building.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

mists.are:41141.name: Yirazi Estate
mists.are:41141.description: Yirazi Estate presents a composed domestic interior built from substantial surfaces and quiet detail. A `wsofa`x rests beneath a long decorative panel, with smaller ornaments arranged in uneven groups rather than strict pairs. Fine wood grain warms the more formal edges. The room has the settled assurance of a house meant to be occupied over time, with room for personal habits to gather around the careful finish.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41144.name: the Tumulus of Arsinoe
mists.are:41144.description: The tumulus encloses Arsinoe's memorial space beneath a heavy mass of earth and stone. Closely fitted masonry gives way to a rougher upper curve, with pale deposits tracing the deepest joints. The visible floor has been kept spare before the more deliberate stonework. The room's solemnity comes from weight and proportion, the sense of a small human purpose protected beneath something much larger.

mists.are:41146.name: A Lavish Home in Larchmont, New York
mists.are:41146.description: The Larchmont home gathers a generous `wsofa`x beneath restrained, carefully finished woodwork. A broad rug keeps the seated arrangement distinct from the clearer outer floor, and a small framed landscape occupies an unexpectedly intimate position beside the furniture. The room is lavish through space and material rather than a crowd of ornament, leaving company room to become comfortable without diminishing the presentation.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41148.name: the Natural Passages beneath Mount Kore
mists.are:41148.description: Natural passages beneath Mount Kore fold through stone with a fine, layered grain. One low ridge rises from the floor before merging into the wall, making the boundary between the two difficult to place. Loose chips have collected in a protected hollow. The cave has a cool mineral smell, and the irregular enclosure returns sound in pieces rather than a single dependable echo.

mists.are:41155.name: Puerto Rico Trench
mists.are:41155.description: The trench drops into a depth the nearer water can only suggest. Suspended particles obscure the smaller contours, while a broad, sloping shape remains visible long enough to make the distance behind it seem greater. Darker water gathers beyond the last readable edge. There is no room-like enclosure here, only the immense, submerged separation between a recognizable surface and whatever lies farther below.

mists.are:41168.name: A Large, Well Appointed Bedroom
mists.are:41168.description: A broad `wbed`x stands beneath a paneled headboard, balanced by a softer rug that reaches beyond the foot. The bedding uses two closely related colors, giving the room depth without a sharp contrast. A small framed print sits above a plain bedside surface. The bedroom is well appointed through proportion and texture, offering a quiet place to rest without filling every spare edge with furniture.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41174.name: the entrance of a cave on the cliffside
mists.are:41174.description: The near ceiling lowers around a rounded projection, the surface layered like folded green-veined rock. The stone changes texture across a crooked line, from fine grain to small, glittering inclusions. The irregular surfaces offer plenty for the eye to follow without resolving into any deliberate arrangement.

mists.are:41176.name: a macabre surgery room
mists.are:41176.description: A narrow `wtreatment table`x occupies the surgery room's most carefully cleared space. Washable surfaces surround it, but the older construction shows through in crooked joints and a stain beneath one fixed fitting. The contrast makes the clinical order feel purposeful rather than reassuring. A sharp cleaning smell hangs over the room, failing to lend any warmth to the spare arrangement.
places: treatment table
Firm padding covers a narrow, easily cleaned table. The raised surface leaves room to stand close on either side, keeping patient and attendant within quiet speaking distance.

mists.are:41177.name: a long hallway lined with individual holding cells
mists.are:41177.description: The hallway runs beside a sequence of individual holding cells. Repeated frames break the wall into narrow intervals, their lower edges marked by a different wear than the clearer passage. A broad patch of floor has been replaced without quite matching the surrounding finish. The corridor makes the cells feel both separate and relentlessly similar, a measured route past a succession of confined spaces.

mists.are:41178.name: a dockside receiving area
mists.are:41178.description: The dockside receiving space is organized around a broad working floor and reinforced lower walls. Old handling marks run toward a stout protective rail, where the metal has been rubbed brighter by bulky loads. The nearer structure holds a faint salt-like crust in the sheltered joints. The room has the practical scale of goods passing through, with no furniture added simply to occupy the margins.

mists.are:41179.name: A luxurious suite, in three rooms
mists.are:41179.description: The luxurious suite reveals three domestic scales within one composed interior: a formal arrival edge, a softer seated arrangement, and a quieter sleeping position. A `wsofa`x gathers the middle beneath restrained decorative panels, while a `wbed`x rests beyond the more public furniture. Closely related colors carry between them. The finish makes the whole feel connected without asking every part of a visit to happen in the same place.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.
bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41187.name: Mt. Damavan, Iran
mists.are:41187.description: The passage within Mount Damavan holds a pale seam high in the rock, visible as a crooked line above darker material. Loose fragments collect below a rough projection, grading from blunt pieces to fine grit. The ground narrows beside the enclosing mass. The mountain is present as texture and pressure, with the cool, sheltered air carrying little suggestion of the open landscape beyond.

mists.are:41194.name: Psych Ward
mists.are:41194.description: The psych ward uses pale finishes and deliberately simple fittings to keep the public interior easy to read. `wWaiting chairs`x sit beside a low divider, their practical spacing allowing company without crowding the clearer floor. A restrained print interrupts the longest blank wall. The room offers order rather than intimacy, with a faint medicinal smell and very few details left to chance.
places: waiting chairs
A row of practical chairs faces into the room. Their edges bear small scuffs from bags and restless hands, and the gaps between them allow a quiet exchange without leaning into the main thoroughfare.

mists.are:41206.name: a cramped shop of esoteric items
mists.are:41206.description: The esoteric shop crowds narrow displays around a modest `wcounter`x. Boxes and small presentation stands vary in shape, with labels that become more careful as the objects become harder to classify. A dark backing makes the pale edges of the nearest display conspicuous. The room smells of paper, packaging, and something dryly aromatic, giving curiosity a comfortable place within the cramped arrangement.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

mists.are:41209.name: Outside the FBI field office, Boston
mists.are:41209.description: The left-hand edge broadens beside a shallow drainage seam cut through dark basalt. A narrow join runs slightly off the line of the surrounding work, recording an earlier patch. The open setting leaves little to contain sound, with the nearest boundaries giving the space a local scale.

mists.are:41212.name: Austin Prepatory
mists.are:41212.description: Austin Prepatory's interior has the durable finish of an institution accustomed to young people moving through it. A narrow display panel presents work in evenly spaced rectangles, while the lower wall carries more practical reinforcement. The floor is clearer through the middle than along the margins. The place combines modest aspiration with the ordinary small knocks of a building used for education.

mists.are:41213.name: godberry chocolate
mists.are:41213.description: Dark, glossy planes divide the space into broad sections, their edges pale where the chocolate-like surface seems to have broken. A berry-colored core shows through one rounded hollow, startling against the deeper brown. The surrounding scale remains softly uncertain. It's a dream of sweetness made architectural, too coherent to dismiss at a glance and too unlikely to accept for long.

mists.are:41214.name: A Smoke-Filled Underground Discotheque
mists.are:41214.description: The underground discotheque presses dark finishes beneath a low, substantial ceiling. A `wsofa`x sits in the quieter margin, the upholstery holding a stale smoke trace beneath the sharper suggestion of perfume. The broad dance surface is crossed by countless fine turns and heel marks. The room feels close and theatrical, making company at the edge seem intimate beside the exposed middle.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41215.name: A circular room, surrounded by balconies and pillars
mists.are:41215.description: Pillars divide the circular room into measured intervals beneath surrounding balconies. Their bases have a heavier finish than the shafts above, giving the lower space a grounded weight despite the repeated curves. A narrow decorative band follows the enclosure without quite meeting evenly at the final join. The room offers many angles on the same center, making a small movement rearrange the whole apparent composition.

mists.are:41218.name: pot broth udon
mists.are:41218.description: Pale, looping forms cross a broad, curved basin at an impossible scale. The enclosing surface has the soft reflection of broth, while darker shapes remain suspended beyond a convincing reach. The room carries the idea of warmth more strongly than any ordinary kitchen smell. Familiar food has become unfamiliar geography, with no sensible boundary between the bowl and the space being occupied.

mists.are:41220.name: a Dilapidated, Oddly Designed Warehouse
mists.are:41220.description: The warehouse refuses the simple proportions expected of an industrial room. A heavy support stands slightly away from the line of the others, and a shallow recess narrows into an angle that seems to serve no practical load. Repairs use different materials without disguising the joins. The dilapidation makes the strange arrangement harder to explain: damage has altered the surfaces, but the oddness seems built into the plan.

mists.are:41226.name: the Brown University Center for Animal Resources and Education
mists.are:41226.description: The animal resources center keeps the working surfaces plain and readily washable. A `wconsultation table`x occupies a clear position beside the more closely fitted stations, giving discussion a separate scale from the practical work. Small labels and measured compartments repeat along the storage. The room has a controlled research character, with a sharp cleaning trace and little decorative material to complicate the finish.
places: consultation table
Chairs face a modest table, keeping everyone within a comfortable speaking distance. The surface is wiped clean and largely bare, leaving room for a closer look at whatever needs explaining.

mists.are:41232.name: Mount Ida, Troas
mists.are:41232.description: Mount Ida's nearer rock shows a broad, sloping face divided by pale mineral threads. Small fragments have gathered beneath the deepest fracture, their fresh edges distinct from the weathered mass above. The immediate ground is uneven and spare. The mountain offers an exposed scale through the shape of the stone, with a stark openness around the exposed ground.

mists.are:41234.name: A manor on a quiet British countryside
mists.are:41234.description: A broad section of honey-colored wood frames the `wsofa`x at the right-hand end, giving the room a comfortable center. A shallow decorative bowl catches the room in a curved, imperfect reflection. The room feels intended for the part of a visit after everyone has stopped deciding where to stand.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41236.name: Administrator Office
mists.are:41236.description: A shallow alcove of brushed steel backs the `wdesk`x at the far end. A plain clock face sits among the wall fittings, modest enough to become conspicuous only during a pause. The ordinary objects make the office feel occupied by a routine even when nobody is carrying it out.
places: desk

The working edge of the desk is smooth beneath the hands, with fine scratches crossing the surface. A visitor's chair faces it at an easy speaking distance, leaving the desktop between the two sides of a conversation.

mists.are:41238.name: A Countryside Villa in Anupharis
mists.are:41238.description: The countryside villa at Anupharis gathers pale wall surfaces around a low `wsofa`x and a simply finished table. A narrow decorative border has been worked by hand, the pattern varying slightly where it turns each corner. Coarser fabric softens the seated position. The room has an unhurried domestic warmth, with the fine details kept close enough to notice while sharing the furniture.
places: sofa
Deep cushions settle into familiar hollows along the sofa. The arms are rubbed smooth, and the upholstery holds a faint fabric warmth; there's room to sit close or claim a comfortable corner.

mists.are:41239.name: The Portalstone
mists.are:41239.description: The Portalstone stands within a close arrangement of worn surfaces, a single more deliberate shape among them. Shallow lines cross the stone and continue around the edges without revealing a complete pattern from one angle. The surrounding floor remains spare. The place draws attention through the contrast between the marked slab and the ordinary material around it, the carved lines seeming sharper each time the eye returns to them.

mists.are:41241.name: A Camp
mists.are:41241.description: The camp is held together by rough supports and fabric that remembers several earlier folds. A patched section crosses one side at an angle, the newer weave a shade tighter than the surrounding shelter. The central ground is clear and firmly used. Canvas and earth give the enclosure a close, temporary smell, with ordinary practicality doing the work of decoration.

mists.are:41242.name: A Battered Parking Garage
mists.are:41242.description: Concrete spans close above the battered parking garage. Old tire arcs overlap faded bay lines, and a protective column wears several layers of chipped paint at bumper height. A broad repair has settled to a slightly different level from the surrounding floor. The enclosure smells faintly of rubber and petroleum, with a low, hard echo beneath the stained overhead spans.

mists.are:41243.name: A Workshop Area
mists.are:41243.description: A sturdy `wworktable`x gives the workshop a clear center of activity. The surface is replaceable, fixed within an older frame whose corners carry a deeper polish from handling. Narrow storage divisions keep the working edges close without crowding them. The room feels practical and personal at once, preserving the small marks of earlier projects in places an ordinary cleanup cannot quite reach.
places: worktable

A broad working surface bears fine cuts, stains, and older repairs. The edge is rubbed smooth where people lean over a project, with enough room for companions to examine the same detail from either side.

mists.are:41244.name: A Private Sleeping Room
mists.are:41244.description: The private sleeping room puts a narrow `wbed`x against the quietest stretch of wall. A folded coverlet adds a darker band at the foot, while a small, undecorated bedside surface keeps the remaining furniture modest. The wall finish is softer around the headboard than near the floor. The enclosure offers privacy through scale, making a lowered voice feel sufficient for the whole room.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41245.name: A Sleeping Tent
mists.are:41245.description: The sleeping tent slopes close around a simple `wbed`x. Broad seams cross the fabric above it, and a doubled lower skirt keeps the ground-level edges heavier than the canopy. A folded blanket adds a rougher texture to the bedding. The shelter smells of canvas and dry fabric, giving rest the intimate, temporary character of something arranged within reach of the wider world.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

mists.are:41248.name: A Cave Nest
mists.are:41248.description: A natural recess forms the cave nest within a broader fold of stone. Finer material has gathered in the protected hollow, while the exposed lip remains rough and uneven. A narrow mineral streak follows the ceiling before vanishing behind the curve. The shelter has an animal-sized practicality enlarged into a room, comfortable only in relation to the harder enclosure surrounding it.

mists.are:41249.name: The Caverns
mists.are:41249.description: The caverns open around a series of rounded stone shoulders. Each one interrupts the next, making the visible space wider than any single clear line through it. Pale deposits have gathered beneath the deeper overhangs, and the floor holds a fan of small broken pieces. The enclosure returns sound from several angles, giving even the nearest rock an uncertain relationship with the depth beyond.

mists.are:41250.name: The Depths
mists.are:41250.description: The depths reveal their structure reluctantly. A broad rock face occupies the nearer view, but the side edges fall away into a space whose limits are difficult to place. Fine mineral lines cross the stone like a map that has lost the larger landscape. The ground remains readable close at hand. Beyond that small certainty, the enclosure seems to continue without offering a comparable scale.

mists.are:41251.name: A Hidden Grove
mists.are:41251.description: The hidden grove is gathered around a low tangle of roots and close, pale-barked trunks. Fine leaves overlap at shoulder height, screening the farther growth without forming a definite wall. A smooth stone has been almost enclosed by two diverging roots. The place feels secluded through accumulation, each small layer of woodland quietly reducing the reach of the view.

mists.are:41253.name: A Hollowed Knothole
mists.are:41253.description: Curved wood encloses the knothole around a small `wresting hollow`x. The lower grain is smooth enough to settle against, while the upper surfaces twist into deeper ridges around a dark knot. Fine bark dust has gathered in the sheltered seams. The tree gives the enclosure a warm, dry smell, making the little refuge feel held within something older and more substantial than ordinary walls.
places: resting hollow
Curved wood shelters a small hollow, the grain worn smooth along the lower surface. The enclosure holds a dry bark smell and fits closely around anyone settling within the tree.

mists.are:41254.name: the barista counter of Deja Brew
mists.are:41254.description: Deja Brew's barista `wcounter`x has a broad working top and a softly rounded customer edge. Cup-shaped marks survive beneath the wiped finish, while a narrow shelf makes a rhythm of small handles above the service fittings. A faded patch in the decorative backing suggests an earlier arrangement. The coffee smell is comfortably settled, giving the compact room the familiarity of a visit almost remembered.
places: counter

The counter's edge has been polished smooth by resting hands. Small scratches cloud the top, leaving a comfortable shared surface for leaning in to talk or examining something laid between companions.

mists.are:41255.name: a messy bedroom and work area
mists.are:41255.description: A rumpled `wbed`x occupies one side of a room that has allowed a project to spread through the rest. The `wworktable`x carries a crowded working patch surrounded by clearer outlines where things have been moved, and a draped piece of fabric nearly bridges the two halves. The disorder is specific rather than shapeless, the visible negotiation between needing somewhere to sleep and being unwilling to stop making something.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.
worktable

A broad working surface bears fine cuts, stains, and older repairs. The edge is rubbed smooth where people lean over a project, with enough room for companions to examine the same detail from either side.

nforest.are:92298.name: The Forest
nforest.are:92298.description: A forked trunk marks the left-hand margin, with rust-colored earth caught in the sheltered angle below it. A shallow impression in the ground has filled with the smaller fragments of fallen leaves. The ground keeps several stages of decay visible at once, from crisp leaves to timber almost returned to soil.

nforest.are:90618.name: The Forest
nforest.are:90618.description: A forked trunk marks the left-hand margin, with weathered bark caught in the sheltered angle below it. The nearest bark peels in narrow curls, showing a smoother tone under the weathered outer layer. There is little here arranged for a visitor, only the patient pressure of plants occupying the available space.

nforest.are:90620.name: The Forest
nforest.are:90620.description: The right-hand undergrowth gathers around a fallen limb whose lower edge has begun to disappear beneath weathered bark. A shallow impression in the ground has filled with the smaller fragments of fallen leaves. Leaf mold gives the sheltered ground a rich smell, while the overlapping growth breaks the distance into small glimpses.

nforest.are:90626.name: The Forest
nforest.are:90626.description: The far forest floor rises over buried timber, exposing a long irregular seam of chalky dust. A leaf has caught upright between two roots, the dry veins more visible than the remaining color. Leaf mold gives the sheltered ground a rich smell, while the overlapping growth breaks the distance into small glimpses.

The ground keeps several stages of decay visible at once, from crisp leaves to timber almost returned to soil.

owforest.are:234238.name: The Forest
owforest.are:234238.description: A narrow hollow in the far ground holds a deeper layer of weathered bark between the roots. Small shelves of fungus cling to a fallen branch, their layered edges softer than the wood beneath them. There is little here arranged for a visitor, only the patient pressure of plants occupying the available space.

owforest.are:234916.name: The Forest
owforest.are:234916.description: The left-hand trunks lean around a small break in the canopy, their bases ringed with green moss. Lichen makes pale islands across the rough bark, changing shape where the grain turns around a knot. There is little here arranged for a visitor, only the patient pressure of plants occupying the available space.

owforest.are:235093.name: The Skies
owforest.are:235093.description: The left-hand surroundings fall away beyond a broad shape of blue-gray shale, leaving the air itself unenclosed. The spaces between the lower shapes look narrower from this height than their separate edges suggest. There is no floor here, only the exposed scale of open air and the distant arrangement beneath it.

samerica.are:36001.name: This is just a test room
samerica.are:36001.description: The right-hand ceiling steps down above a squared structural pier faced in dark wood. A line of shallow grooves gives the lower wall a rhythm that changes as the passage is viewed end-on. The repeated lines give the passage a quiet momentum, drawing attention along the building rather than into the margins.

samerica.are:36002.name: the grand, ice-cold entrance hall
samerica.are:36002.description: The right-hand floor widens beside the `wwaiting bench`x, making a small pause within the larger circulation space. The lower wall finish is sturdier than the panels above, built to survive bags and passing coats. The public surfaces carry a faint polish smell, with the quieter seating set just beyond the main flow. Broad proportions give the central space room to breathe.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

samerica.are:36003.name: a desolate vine-encroached hallway of cold stone
samerica.are:36003.description: The left-hand wall steps inward around a shallow structural pier faced in brushed steel. The ceiling joints converge slightly off-center, lending the passage an unobtrusive asymmetry. The restrained details become noticeable during a pause, then fall back into the ordinary business of passing through.

samerica.are:36004.name: a desolate vine-encroached hallway of cold stone
samerica.are:36004.description: The ceiling drops slightly toward the near wall, where white ceramic picks out the change in level. A narrow patch in the flooring crosses the usual line of travel at a diagonal. The clear passage carries sound farther than the close walls first suggest.

samerica.are:36007.name: Teatro Colon - Buenos Aires
samerica.are:36007.description: Formal architectural trim surrounds a broad performance interior. Audience seats faces the presentation space, with the room's large proportions lending even an empty gathering a ceremonial scale.

samerica.are:36008.name: a desolate vine-encroached hallway of cold stone
samerica.are:36008.description: The ceiling drops slightly toward the left-hand wall, where sand-colored plaster picks out the change in level. One broad panel is set back just far enough to catch a thin border of shadow. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

samerica.are:36009.name: a desolate vine-encroached hallway of cold stone
samerica.are:36009.description: A vertical seam divides the far finish into two unequal panels of sand-colored plaster. One broad panel is set back just far enough to catch a thin border of shadow. The enclosure makes a small sound feel near even when the source lies beyond the immediate view.

samerica.are:36010.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - Pathing Point
samerica.are:36010.description: A deep structural recess breaks the right-hand wall into a narrower bay behind the main floor. A protective rail sits close to the base of the structure, rubbed brighter where bulky loads have passed. The clear bays show their purpose through structure rather than decoration.

samerica.are:36015.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - La Jolie Villa Felicienne, Lobby
samerica.are:36015.description: A `wwaiting bench`x rests along the left-hand wall beneath a broad band of blue-gray paint. A framed abstract print offers a restrained patch of color at seated eye level. The public surfaces carry a faint polish smell, with the quieter seating set just beyond the main flow.
places: waiting bench
The bench has a smooth seat and a back marked by the rub of countless coats. From here, arrivals remain in view while the busiest line across the floor passes a little farther away.

samerica.are:36016.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - La Jolie Villa Felicienne, Landing
samerica.are:36016.description: A shallow recess in the left-hand wall breaks the repeating geometry of the stair, exposing a different plane of sand-colored plaster. A broader tread interrupts the climb, the corners polished smoother than the wide, shallow center. The enclosure gives each small sound a short, climbing echo.

samerica.are:36017.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - La Jolie Villa Felicienne, Room One
samerica.are:36017.description: The `wbed`x lies off-center toward the far side, balanced by a shallow wall recess finished in pearl-gray paint. A small fabric wall hanging has an uneven lower edge, with a single thread curling away from the weave. The arrangement makes rest feel private without shutting company out of the small space beside the bed.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

samerica.are:36018.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - La Jolie Villa Felicienne, Room Two
samerica.are:36018.description: A `wbed`x sits against the right-hand wall beneath a broad headboard framed in dark walnut. Fine vertical grain runs through the nearest wooden fitting, interrupted by one pale, oval knot. There is little here that demands attention; the small textures become more noticeable the longer anyone stays.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

samerica.are:36019.name: Guadeloupe, Caribbean - La Jolie Villa Felicienne, Room Three
samerica.are:36019.description: A narrow band of pearl-gray paint follows the right-hand wall behind the `wbed`x, giving the sleeping corner a quiet emphasis. A plain rug ends just short of the sleeping furniture, leaving a crescent of bare floor beside the mattress. The room smells faintly of aired bedding, with a drier trace of wood beneath it.
places: bed
The mattress yields beneath creased bedding, with a firmer edge for sitting beside someone. Soft fabric muffles small movements, bringing a quiet conversation within reach of the pillows.

samerica.are:36024.name: Cave
samerica.are:36024.description: A slanted seam of chalky stone divides the left-hand rock face into two differently grained masses. A thin crust bridges a narrow crack, fragile-looking beside the mass on either side. The rock gives sound an uneven return, sometimes close and sometimes swallowed by the surrounding folds.

samerica.are:36025.name: Cave
samerica.are:36025.description: The near wall opens into a shallow natural hollow lined with rust-colored sandstone. The floor holds a fan of broken chips, grading from blunt fragments to fine grit. The rock gives sound an uneven return, sometimes close and sometimes swallowed by the surrounding folds.

samerica.are:36029.name: A Bar in Barbados
samerica.are:36029.description: The `wbar`x turns around the left-hand corner, giving the tavern two slightly different angles of conversation. Old drink rings lie beneath the finish in overlapping circles, some broad and pale, others small and dark. The room offers a choice between the shared counter and the smaller company gathered around a table. Small `wtables`x occupy the quieter margin, their tops softly marked by old cups and plates.
places: bar

Old drink rings overlap in the bar's dark finish. The edge is smooth beneath an elbow, and the long shared counter brings neighboring patrons within easy reach of a remark or a quietly exchanged confidence.
tables
Small tables provide close-set seats for conversation.

samerica.are:36035.name: Inside a Small Bamboo Hut
samerica.are:36035.description: Close walls shelter a modest domestic space. Wear shows in the familiar routes across the floor and the small marks left at hand height. The enclosed air carries a trace of settled dust and everyday living, giving the room the private scale of somewhere to return to. The close proportions leave little spare space between the room's edges.

samerica.are:36038.description: A square patch of honey-colored wood marks the near wall where the surrounding finish changes depth. Small pinholes form an uneven line just above the height of a raised hand. There is a faint mineral smell beneath the dry air, the scent of a room reduced to the materials that make it.

samerica.are:36039.description: A strip of dark walnut stops short of the near corner, exposing the construction beneath the finish. A narrow shadow lies inside the deepest joint, emphasizing the spare geometry. The open floor makes the slightest unevenness conspicuous, a landscape of small seams and shallow shadows.

samerica.are:36040.description: Two broad planes meet at an awkward angle on the near side, with muted green paint picked out along the join. Fine tool strokes remain visible beneath the last layer of wall finish. The undecorated surfaces leave the proportions unusually easy to read, from the low corners to the open middle.

samerica.are:36041.description: Two broad planes meet at an awkward angle on the right-hand side, with muted green paint picked out along the join. The ceiling has a shallow step that makes one corner seem unexpectedly close. The undecorated surfaces leave the proportions unusually easy to read, from the low corners to the open middle.

samerica.are:36042.description: A square patch of warm terracotta marks the near wall where the surrounding finish changes depth. The floor carries a faint rectangular outline, clearer at one end than the other. There is a faint mineral smell beneath the dry air, the scent of a room reduced to the materials that make it.

samerica.are:36043.description: A strip of muted green paint stops short of the right-hand corner, exposing the construction beneath the finish. The lower edges are rounded where an otherwise sharp finish meets the floor. The quiet has an unfinished quality, as though the next ordinary use might finally give the space a character.

samerica.are:36044.description: Two broad planes meet at an awkward angle on the left-hand side, with muted green paint picked out along the join. wforest.are:133991.name: The Forest
wforest.are:133991.description: A forked trunk marks the right-hand margin, with dark leaf mold caught in the sheltered angle below it. The nearest bark peels in narrow curls, showing a smoother tone under the weathered outer layer. The ground keeps several stages of decay visible at once, from crisp leaves to timber almost returned to soil.

wforest.are:134013.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134013.description: A broad root shoulder breaks the left-hand ground, lifting a skin of weathered bark above the leaf litter. The nearest bark peels in narrow curls, showing a smoother tone under the weathered outer layer. The ground keeps several stages of decay visible at once, from crisp leaves to timber almost returned to soil.

wforest.are:134015.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134015.description: A forked trunk marks the left-hand margin, with dark leaf mold caught in the sheltered angle below it. The nearest bark peels in narrow curls, showing a smoother tone under the weathered outer layer. The woodland is close without becoming a room; the enclosure belongs to growth rather than walls.

wforest.are:134017.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134017.description: A broad root shoulder breaks the left-hand ground, lifting a skin of green moss above the leaf litter. Fine twigs lie crosswise over broader branches, building a delicate lattice close to the soil. The nearest textures are easy to follow, but the tangle beyond them resists a clear, uninterrupted view.

wforest.are:134185.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134185.description: A forked trunk marks the near margin, with chalky dust caught in the sheltered angle below it. Lichen makes pale islands across the rough bark, changing shape where the grain turns around a knot. Leaf mold gives the sheltered ground a rich smell, while the overlapping growth breaks the distance into small glimpses.

wforest.are:134187.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134187.description: The near forest floor rises over buried timber, exposing a long irregular seam of chalky dust. Small shelves of fungus cling to a fallen branch, their layered edges softer than the wood beneath them. There is little here arranged for a visitor, only the patient pressure of plants occupying the available space.

wforest.are:134203.name: The Forest
wforest.are:134203.description: The right-hand undergrowth gathers around a fallen limb whose lower edge has begun to disappear beneath chalky dust. New growth threads through an older tangle, making a finer green texture among the heavier stems.
